AI.title_translation: 轻量级高效遥感图像分割解码器：LightFormer
AI.tldr: LightFormer是一种轻量级解码器，通过特征融合、通道处理、门控机制和空间信息选择模块（SISM）来提高效率和准确性，适用于资源受限的遥感图像分割任务。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习方法在遥感图像分割中面临解码器复杂度高，难以在边缘设备上实时部署的问题。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为LightFormer的轻量级解码器，其特点是：1. 包含一个基于通道处理和可学习门控机制的特征融合与精炼模块，用于高效聚合多尺度、多范围信息。2. 引入了空间信息选择模块（SISM），结合了长程注意力机制和一个细节保留分支，以捕捉多尺度的空间依赖性。
AI.result: 在ISPRS Vaihingen基准测试中，LightFormer达到了GLFFNet的99.9%的mIoU（83.9% vs 84.0%），但仅使用了GLFFNet的14.7%的FLOPs和15.9%的参数。在LoveDA、ISPRS Potsdam、RescueNet和FloodNet数据集上也有良好的表现。
AI.conclusion: LightFormer在保证高精度的同时显著降低了模型复杂度，为需要计算经济性和高精度分割的遥感应用提供了一个实用解决方案。
AI.translation: 深度学习技术在遥感图像的语义分割和土地利用变化检测方面取得了显著成功。然而，它们在边缘设备上的实时部署仍然受到解码器复杂度的限制。本文介绍了一种用于时间关键型任务的轻量级解码器LightFormer，该任务涉及非结构化目标，例如灾害评估、无人机搜索与救援以及文化遗产监测。LightFormer采用了一个基于通道处理和可学习门控机制的特征融合与精炼模块，以高效地聚合多尺度、多范围的信息，从而大大降低了模型复杂度。此外，我们提出了一种空间信息选择模块（SISM），它集成了长程注意力和一个细节保留分支，以捕捉多尺度的空间依赖性，从而显著提高了对复杂场景中非结构化目标的识别能力。在ISPRS Vaihingen基准测试中，LightFormer达到了GLFFNet的99.9%的mIoU（83.9% vs 84.0%），而仅需其FLOPs的14.7%和参数的15.9%，从而实现了出色的精度-效率权衡。在LoveDA、ISPRS Potsdam、RescueNet和FloodNet上的持续结果进一步证明了其鲁棒性和对非结构化物体的卓越感知能力。这些发现凸显了LightFormer作为遥感应用的一个实用解决方案，在这些应用中，计算经济性和高精度分割都至关重要。
AI.summary: LightFormer是一种新提出的轻量级解码器，旨在解决遥感图像分割中现有深度学习模型复杂度高、边缘部署困难的问题。它通过创新的特征融合、通道处理、门控机制以及空间信息选择模块（SISM），有效地聚合多尺度信息并捕捉空间依赖性，同时显著降低了计算量和参数量。实验结果表明，LightFormer在保持高分割精度的同时，实现了出色的效率提升，为实时遥感应用提供了有效的解决方案。
AI.keywords: LightFormer, 遥感图像分割, 轻量级解码器, 效率, 精度
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种名为LightFormer的轻量级解码器，在遥感图像分割领域取得了显著的效率和精度提升。其创新之处在于引入了特征融合与精炼模块以及空间信息选择模块（SISM），这些模块能够有效处理多尺度信息和空间依赖性，同时大幅降低计算成本。研究在多个数据集上验证了LightFormer的有效性，尤其是在ISPRS Vaihingen基准测试中，其性能接近先进模型，但计算量却大大减少。这使得LightFormer成为在计算资源受限的边缘设备上进行实时遥感图像分割的理想选择。然而，文章未深入探讨其在不同类型非结构化目标上的泛化能力，以及在更复杂、噪声更大的真实世界场景中的鲁棒性。

title: Climbing the Ladder of Reasoning: What LLMs Can-and Still Can't-Solve after SFT?
summary: Recent supervised fine-tuning (SFT) approaches have significantly improved language models' performance on mathematical reasoning tasks, even when models are trained at a small scale. However, the specific capabilities enhanced through such fine-tuning remain poorly understood. In this paper, we conduct a detailed analysis of model performance on the AIME24 dataset to understand how reasoning capabilities evolve. We discover a ladder-like structure in problem difficulty, categorize questions into four tiers (Easy, Medium, Hard, and Extremely Hard (Exh)), and identify the specific requirements for advancing between tiers. We find that progression from Easy to Medium tier requires adopting an R1 reasoning style with minimal SFT (500-1K instances), while Hard-level questions suffer from frequent model's errors at each step of the reasoning chain, with accuracy plateauing at around 65% despite logarithmic scaling. Exh-level questions present a fundamentally different challenge; they require unconventional problem-solving skills that current models uniformly struggle with. Additional findings reveal that carefully curated small-scale datasets offer limited advantage-scaling dataset size proves far more effective. Our analysis provides a clearer roadmap for advancing language model capabilities in mathematical reasoning.

AI.title_translation: 攀登推理之梯：SFT后的LLM在能解决和仍不能解决的问题是什么？
AI.tldr: SFT提升了LLM的数学推理能力，但研究发现问题难度呈阶梯状分布。从简单到中等需要少量SFT和R1风格；困难问题在推理链中受阻，准确率封顶；特难问题需要模型具备当前不具备的非常规技能。数据规模的扩大比小数据集的精选更有效。
AI.motivation: 现有的监督微调（SFT）方法显著提高了语言模型在数学推理任务上的性能，但这种微调具体增强了哪些推理能力仍不清楚，因此需要进行详细分析以理解推理能力如何演进。
AI.method: 对AIME24数据集进行详细分析，将问题按难度分为四个层级（简单、中等、困难、特难），并根据模型在不同层级的表现，识别出跨越层级所需的特定推理风格（如R1）和SFT数据量要求。同时，通过比较数据集规模扩展的有效性来评估数据需求。
AI.result: 研究发现了问题难度的阶梯结构，并确定了进阶要求：从“简单”到“中等”需要采用R1推理风格和少量SFT（500-1K实例）；“困难”级问题在推理链的每一步都会出现错误，准确率在约65%处停滞；“特难”级问题需要模型具备当前普遍缺乏的非常规解题技能。此外，扩大数据集规模比精心策划的小规模数据集更有效。
AI.conclusion: 对AIME24数据集的分析揭示了问题难度的阶梯结构，并明确了从低难度到高难度问题所需的推理能力和SFT数据量。虽然SFT能带来显著提升，但要解决最难的问题，需要超越当前模型普遍缺乏的非常规解题技能，并且扩大数据集规模比精选小规模数据集更有效。
AI.translation: 最近的监督微调（SFT）方法显著提高了语言模型在数学推理任务上的性能，即使在小规模训练下也是如此。然而，通过这种微调具体增强的能力仍然知之甚少。在本文中，我们对AIME24数据集上的模型性能进行了详细分析，以了解推理能力如何演变。我们发现问题难度存在一个阶梯状结构，将问题分为四个层级（简单、中等、困难和特难（Exh）），并确定了在各层级之间推进所需的具体要求。我们发现，从简单到中等层级的进展需要采用具有最少SFT（500-1K实例）的R1推理风格，而“困难”级问题在推理链的每一步都会出现模型错误，准确率在对数缩放的情况下仍停滞在约65%。特难级问题提出了一个根本不同的挑战；它们需要当前模型普遍挣扎的非常规解题技能。额外的发现表明，精心策划的小规模数据集提供的优势有限——扩大数据集规模被证明更为有效。我们的分析为推进语言模型在数学推理方面的能力提供了更清晰的路线图。
AI.summary: 本文通过对AIME24数据集的详细分析，揭示了语言模型在数学推理能力上存在一个清晰的“阶梯结构”，并量化了从低难度到高难度问题所需的具体推理能力和SFT数据需求。研究发现，虽然SFT能帮助模型掌握基本推理（如R1风格），但要解决更难的问题，模型仍缺乏必要的非常规解题技巧，且扩大训练数据规模是提升性能的关键。
AI.keywords: SFT, 数学推理, AIME24, 难度分层, 理由链,
AI.comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于识别了数学推理问题难度中的“阶梯结构”，并量化了从一个难度层级（如“简单”到“中等”）进阶到下一层级所需的具体推理风格（R1）和SFT数据量。然而，其局限性在于仅关注AIME24数据集，且对“特难”问题的分析停留在“模型普遍挣扎”的描述，缺乏更深入的机制探究。

title: SLAM&Render: A Benchmark for the Intersection Between Neural Rendering, Gaussian Splatting and SLAM
comments: 9 pages, 8 figures, submitted to The International Journal of Robotics Research (IJRR)
summary: Models and methods originally developed for Novel View Synthesis and Scene Rendering, such as Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) and Gaussian Splatting, are increasingly being adopted as representations in Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM). However, existing datasets fail to include the specific challenges of both fields, such as sequential operations and, in many settings, multi-modality in SLAM or generalization across viewpoints and illumination conditions in neural rendering. Additionally, the data are often collected using sensors which are handheld or mounted on drones or mobile robots, which complicates the accurate reproduction of sensor motions. To bridge these gaps, we introduce SLAM&Render, a novel dataset designed to benchmark methods in the intersection between SLAM, Novel View Rendering and Gaussian Splatting. Recorded with a robot manipulator, it uniquely includes 40 sequences with time-synchronized RGB-D images, IMU readings, robot kinematic data, and ground-truth pose streams. By releasing robot kinematic data, the dataset also enables the assessment of recent integrations of SLAM paradigms within robotic applications. The dataset features five setups with consumer and industrial objects under four controlled lighting conditions, each with separate training and test trajectories. All sequences are static with different levels of object rearrangements and occlusions. Our experimental results, obtained with several baselines from the literature, validate SLAM&Render as a relevant benchmark for this emerging research area.
comment: 9 pages, 8 figures, submitted to The International Journal of Robotics Research (IJRR)

AI.title_translation: SLAM与渲染：神经渲染、高斯泼溅与SLAM交叉领域基准测试
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了SLAM&Render数据集，用于评估结合了SLAM、神经渲染和高斯泼溅技术的方法。该数据集包含机器人操作员采集的同步RGB-D图像、IMU读数、机器人运动学数据和地面真实位姿，解决了现有数据集在顺序操作、多模态、视角和光照变化等方面的不足，适用于评估机器人应用中的SLAM集成。
AI.motivation: 现有数据集未能充分涵盖神经渲染和SLAM交叉领域的特定挑战，例如顺序操作、多模态、视角和光照变化，并且难以精确复制传感器运动，因此需要一个能够桥接这些差距的新数据集。
AI.method: 通过机器人操作员采集了包含40个序列的数据集，这些序列同步了RGB-D图像、IMU读数、机器人运动学数据和地面真实位姿。数据集包含五个设置，涉及消费级和工业级物体，并在四种可控光照条件下进行，每个设置都有独立的训练和测试轨迹。所有序列均为静态场景，具有不同程度的物体重新排列和遮挡。
AI.result: 使用文献中的几种基线方法进行的实验结果验证了SLAM&Render作为该新兴研究领域相关基准测试的有效性。
AI.conclusion: SLAM&Render数据集为神经渲染、高斯泼溅和SLAM交叉领域的研究提供了一个全面的基准测试平台，其设计解决了现有数据集的局限性，并能评估机器人应用中的SLAM集成。
AI.translation: 模型和方法最初为新颖视图合成和场景渲染而开发，例如神经辐射场（NeRF）和高斯泼溅，正越来越多地被用作同时定位与地图构建（SLAM）中的表示。然而，现有数据集未能包含这两个领域的特定挑战，例如许多设置中的顺序操作和多模态，或神经渲染中的跨视角和光照条件泛化。此外，数据通常使用手持式或安装在无人机或移动机器人上的传感器收集，这使得传感器运动的精确复制变得复杂。为了弥合这些差距，我们引入了SLAM&Render，一个旨在为SLAM、新颖视图渲染和高斯泼溅交叉领域的方法设定基准的新型数据集。它由机器人操作员录制，独特地包含40个序列，包含时间同步的RGB-D图像、IMU读数、机器人运动学数据和地面真实位姿流。通过发布机器人运动学数据，该数据集还能评估近期SLAM范式在机器人应用中的集成。该数据集具有五个设置，涉及消费级和工业级物体，在四种可控光照条件下，每个设置都有独立的训练和测试轨迹。所有序列均为静态场景，具有不同程度的物体重新排列和遮挡。我们使用文献中的几种基线进行的实验结果，验证了SLAM&Render作为该新兴研究领域相关基准测试的有效性。
AI.summary: SLAM&Render 是一个新颖的数据集，旨在为神经渲染、高斯泼溅和 SLAM 的交叉领域提供基准测试。该数据集通过机器人操作员采集，包含同步的 RGB-D 图像、IMU 读数、机器人运动学数据和地面真实位姿，解决了现有数据集在处理顺序操作、多模态、视角和光照变化方面的不足，并支持对机器人应用中 SLAM 集成的评估。
AI.keywords: SLAM, 神经渲染, 高斯泼溅, 数据集, 基准测试
AI.comments: 该数据集的创新之处在于其对神经渲染和 SLAM 交叉领域的关注，并提供了包含机器人运动学数据的独特数据。然而，数据集的静态场景设置可能限制了其在动态环境下的评估能力。未来可以考虑增加动态场景的数据。

title: Subject-driven Video Generation via Disentangled Identity and Motion
summary: We propose to train a subject-driven customized video generation model through decoupling the subject-specific learning from temporal dynamics in zero-shot without additional tuning. A traditional method for video customization that is tuning-free often relies on large, annotated video datasets, which are computationally expensive and require extensive annotation. In contrast to the previous approach, we introduce the use of an image customization dataset directly on training video customization models, factorizing the video customization into two folds: (1) identity injection through image customization dataset and (2) temporal modeling preservation with a small set of unannotated videos through the image-to-video training method. Additionally, we employ random image token dropping with randomized image initialization during image-to-video fine-tuning to mitigate the copy-and-paste issue. To further enhance learning, we introduce stochastic switching during joint optimization of subject-specific and temporal features, mitigating catastrophic forgetting. Our method achieves strong subject consistency and scalability, outperforming existing video customization models in zero-shot settings, demonstrating the effectiveness of our framework.

AI.title_translation: 主体驱动的视频生成：通过解耦身份和运动
AI.tldr: 提出了一种新的零样本视频定制框架，它通过图像数据集注入身份信息，并使用少量视频学习时间动态，避免了传统方法对大量标注数据的依赖，有效解决了“复制粘贴”和灾难性遗忘问题，并在零样本测试中表现出色。
AI.motivation: 传统调优免费的视频定制方法依赖于大型、带注释的视频数据集，这计算成本高且需要大量注释。本研究旨在提出一种新的方法，通过使用图像定制数据集直接训练视频定制模型，避免这些限制。
AI.method: 通过图像定制数据集实现身份注入，并通过少量未标注视频利用图像到视频训练方法保持时间建模，在联合优化中引入随机切换以缓解灾难性遗忘，并在微调中采用随机图像Token丢弃和随机初始化来避免复制粘贴问题。
AI.result: 实现了强大的主体一致性和可扩展性，在零样本设置下性能优于现有视频定制模型。
AI.conclusion: 我们提出的方法实现了强大的主体一致性和可扩展性，在零样本设置下优于现有的视频定制模型，证明了我们框架的有效性。
AI.translation: 我们提出通过在零样本下对主体特定的学习与时间动态进行解耦，来训练一个主体驱动的定制视频生成模型，而无需额外的微调。传统的免微调视频定制方法通常依赖于大型、带注释的视频数据集，这在计算上成本高昂，并且需要大量的注释。与以前的方法相反，我们引入了直接在训练视频定制模型时使用图像定制数据集，将视频定制分解为两个方面：（1）通过图像定制数据集进行身份注入；（2）通过图像到视频训练方法，使用少量未标注视频来保持时间建模。此外，我们在图像到视频微调期间采用随机图像Token丢弃和随机图像初始化，以减轻复制粘贴问题。为了进一步增强学习，我们在主体特定特征和时间特征的联合优化中引入了随机切换，以缓解灾难性遗忘。我们的方法实现了强大的主体一致性和可扩展性，在零样本设置下优于现有的视频定制模型，证明了我们框架的有效性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种通过解耦主体特定学习和时间动态来训练零样本主体驱动视频生成模型的方法。该方法不依赖昂贵的大型带注释数据集，而是利用图像定制数据集进行身份注入，并结合少量未标注视频进行时间建模，同时引入随机Token丢弃和随机切换策略来解决常见问题并增强学习效果，从而实现了高性能的零样本视频定制。
AI.keywords: 主体驱动视频生成, 解耦身份, 零样本定制, 图像到视频训练, 时间动态
AI.comments: 该方法的创新点在于利用图像定制数据集进行零样本视频定制训练，有效解耦了身份信息和时间动态，并引入了随机图像Token丢弃和随机初始化来解决“复制粘贴”问题，同时使用随机切换来缓解灾难性遗忘，提升了模型的可扩展性和零样本性能。

title: Detect, Explain, Escalate: Sustainable Dialogue Breakdown Management for LLM Agents
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated substantial capabilities in conversational AI applications, yet their susceptibility to dialogue breakdowns poses significant challenges to deployment reliability and user trust. This paper introduces a "Detect, Explain, Escalate" framework to manage dialogue breakdowns in LLM-powered agents, emphasizing resource-efficient operation. Our approach integrates two key strategies: (1) We fine-tune a compact 8B-parameter model, augmented with teacher-generated reasoning traces, which serves as an efficient real-time breakdown detector and explainer. This model demonstrates robust classification and calibration on English and Japanese dialogues, and generalizes to the BETOLD dataset, improving accuracy by 7% over its baseline. (2) We systematically evaluate frontier LLMs using advanced prompting (few-shot, chain-of-thought, analogical reasoning) for high-fidelity breakdown assessment. These are integrated into an "escalation" architecture where our efficient detector defers to larger models only when necessary, substantially reducing operational costs and computational overhead. Our fine-tuned model and prompting strategies achieve state-of-the-art performance on DBDC5 and strong results on BETOLD, outperforming specialized classifiers on DBDC5 and narrowing the performance gap to larger proprietary models. The proposed monitor-escalate pipeline reduces inference costs by 54%, providing a cost-effective and interpretable solution for robust conversational AI in high-impact domains. Code and models are publicly available.

AI.title_translation: 检测、解释、升级：面向LLM代理的可持续对话中断管理
AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种“检测、解释、升级”框架，通过微调小型模型进行实时中断检测和解释，并结合先进的提示策略评估大型模型，以实现资源高效的对话中断管理，显著降低了运营成本并提高了鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLM）在对话AI应用中能力强大，但容易出现对话中断，影响部署的可靠性和用户信任。因此，需要一种有效且资源节约的方法来管理这些中断。
AI.method: 1. 微调一个包含8B参数的小型模型，并加入教师生成的推理痕迹，用于实时检测和解释对话中断。该模型在英语和日语对话中表现出良好的分类和校准能力，并能泛化到BETOLD数据集。2. 使用少样本、思维链和类比推理等先进提示策略，系统评估前沿LLM在对话中断评估方面的能力。3. 构建一个“升级”架构，仅在必要时才将检测任务交给大型模型，以降低成本和计算开销。
AI.result: 微调后的模型在DBDC5和BETOLD数据集上均取得最先进的性能，在DBDC5上超越了专用分类器，并缩小了与大型专有模型的性能差距。监视-升级管道将推理成本降低了54%，为高影响力领域中的鲁棒对话AI提供了经济高效且可解释的解决方案。
AI.conclusion: “检测、解释、升级”框架通过结合高效的微调模型和先进的提示策略，提供了一种可持续且经济高效的方法来管理LLM代理中的对话中断，从而提高了对话AI的可靠性和用户信任度。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLM）在对话AI应用中展现出强大的能力，但其对话中断的易感性对部署的可靠性和用户信任构成了重大挑战。本文引入了一个“检测、解释、升级”框架来管理LLM驱动的代理中的对话中断，并强调了资源效率。我们的方法整合了两种关键策略：（1）我们微调了一个包含80亿参数的紧凑模型，并辅以教师生成的推理痕迹，该模型可作为高效的实时中断检测器和解释器。该模型在英语和日语对话中展现出强大的分类和校准能力，并能泛化到BETOLD数据集，准确率比基线提高了7%。（2）我们使用先进的提示（少样本、思维链、类比推理）来系统评估前沿LLM的高保真度中断评估能力。这些被整合到一个“升级”架构中，其中我们的高效检测器仅在必要时才求助于更大的模型，从而显著降低了运营成本和计算开销。我们的微调模型和提示策略在DBDC5上取得了最先进的性能，在BETOLD上也取得了强劲的结果，在DBDC5上超越了专用分类器，并缩小了与大型专有模型的性能差距。提出的监视-升级管道将推理成本降低了54%，为高影响力领域中鲁棒的对话AI提供了一个成本效益高且可解释的解决方案。代码和模型是公开可用的。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为“检测、解释、升级”的框架，用于管理大型语言模型（LLM）代理中的对话中断。该框架结合了一个经过微调的小型（8B参数）模型，用于高效地检测和解释中断，并利用先进的提示策略来评估大型模型。通过将小型模型作为首选检测器，并仅在必要时才调用大型模型，该方法显著降低了计算成本和运营开销，同时保持了高准确性。该框架在多个数据集上取得了最先进的性能，并提供了一个经济高效、可解释的解决方案，以提高对话AI的可靠性。
AI.keywords: 对话中断管理,大型语言模型,资源效率,模型升级,可解释性AI
AI.comments: 这项研究解决了LLM在实际应用中一个关键的痛点——对话中断管理。通过结合小型高效模型和大型模型的优势，并引入“升级”机制，该方法在性能和成本之间取得了良好的平衡。代码和模型的公开可用性也增加了该研究的价值和影响力。

title: ReVision: Refining Video Diffusion with Explicit 3D Motion Modeling
comments: TMLR camera-ready version. Project Page: https://revision-video.github.io/
summary: In recent years, video generation has seen significant advancements. However, challenges still persist in generating complex motions and interactions. To address these challenges, we introduce ReVision, a plug-and-play framework that explicitly integrates parameterized 3D model knowledge into a pretrained conditional video generation model, significantly enhancing its ability to generate high-quality videos with complex motion and interactions. Specifically, ReVision consists of three stages. First, a video diffusion model is used to generate a coarse video. Next, we extract a set of 2D and 3D features from the coarse video to construct a 3D object-centric representation, which is then refined by our proposed parameterized motion prior model to produce an accurate 3D motion sequence. Finally, this refined motion sequence is fed back into the same video diffusion model as additional conditioning, enabling the generation of motion-consistent videos, even in scenarios involving complex actions and interactions. We validate the effectiveness of our approach on Stable Video Diffusion, where ReVision significantly improves motion fidelity and coherence. Remarkably, with only 1.5B parameters, it even outperforms a state-of-the-art video generation model with over 13B parameters on complex video generation by a substantial margin. Our results suggest that, by incorporating 3D motion knowledge, even a relatively small video diffusion model can generate complex motions and interactions with greater realism and controllability, offering a promising solution for physically plausible video generation.
comment: TMLR camera-ready version. Project Page: https://revision-video.github.io/

AI.title_translation: ReVision：使用显式3D运动建模精炼视频扩散模型
AI.tldr: ReVision是一个新的、即插即用的框架，它将参数化的3D运动知识注入到现有的视频扩散模型中，通过三步精炼过程（粗糙生成 -> 3D运动细化 -> 运动条件反馈），显著提高了模型生成复杂、高保真、运动一致视频的能力，甚至超越了参数量大得多的SOTA模型。
AI.motivation: 现有的视频生成模型在生成复杂的运动和交互方面仍然存在挑战。
AI.method: ReVision框架分三个阶段：1. 使用视频扩散模型生成粗糙视频；2. 从粗糙视频中提取2D和3D特征，构建3D以物体为中心的表示，并使用参数化运动先验模型细化以获得准确的3D运动序列；3. 将精炼后的运动序列作为附加条件反馈给相同的视频扩散模型，以生成运动一致的视频。
AI.result: 在Stable Video Diffusion上验证了有效性，ReVision显著提高了运动保真度和一致性。值得注意的是，ReVision（仅1.5B参数）在复杂视频生成方面大幅超越了一个超过13B参数的SOTA视频生成模型。
AI.conclusion: 通过整合3D运动知识，即使相对较小的视频扩散模型也能以更高的真实感和可控性生成复杂的运动和交互，为生成物理上合理的视频提供了一个有前景的解决方案。
AI.translation: 近年来，视频生成取得了显著进展。然而，生成复杂的运动和交互仍然存在挑战。为解决这些挑战，我们引入了ReVision，一个即插即用的框架，它将参数化的3D模型知识显式地集成到一个预训练的条件视频生成模型中，显著增强了其生成具有复杂运动和交互的高质量视频的能力。具体来说，ReVision包含三个阶段。首先，使用视频扩散模型生成一个粗糙视频。其次，我们从粗糙视频中提取一组2D和3D特征，以构建一个3D以物体为中心的表示，然后通过我们提出的参数化运动先验模型对其进行细化，以产生一个精确的3D运动序列。最后，将这个精炼的运动序列作为附加条件反馈给相同的视频扩散模型，从而生成运动一致的视频，即使在涉及复杂动作和交互的场景中也是如此。我们在Stable Video Diffusion上验证了我们方法的有效性，ReVision显著提高了运动保真度和一致性。值得注意的是，仅有1.5B参数的ReVision在复杂视频生成方面大幅超越了一个拥有超过13B参数的SOTA视频生成模型。我们的结果表明，通过结合3D运动知识，即使相对较小的视频扩散模型也能以更高的真实感和可控性生成复杂的运动和交互，为生成物理上合理的视频提供了一个有前景的解决方案。
AI.summary: ReVision是一个即插即用的框架，旨在通过显式整合参数化的3D模型知识来改进预训练的视频扩散模型，以解决复杂运动和交互生成中的挑战。它通过一个三阶段过程（粗糙生成、3D运动细化、运动条件反馈）实现这一点，结果表明它能显著提高运动保真度，并且在参数量远小于SOTA模型的情况下取得了更优异的性能。
AI.keywords: 视频生成, 3D运动建模, 扩散模型, 运动一致性, 显式建模
AI.comments: ReVision的创新之处在于它是一个即插即用的框架，通过明确整合参数化3D模型知识来改进预训练的视频扩散模型，特别是在处理复杂运动和交互方面。其重要性在于，它表明通过引入3D运动知识，一个相对较小的模型也能超越参数量大得多的SOTA模型，为生成物理上合理的视频提供了有前景的解决方案。局限性方面，摘要没有明确提及，但其依赖于预训练模型和提取的特征，可能在某些未见过的复杂场景中存在泛化挑战。

title: Dynamic and Distributed Routing in IoT Networks based on Multi-Objective Q-Learning
summary: IoT networks often face conflicting routing goals such as maximizing packet delivery, minimizing delay, and conserving limited battery energy. These priorities can also change dynamically: for example, an emergency alert requires high reliability, while routine monitoring prioritizes energy efficiency to prolong network lifetime. Existing works, including many deep reinforcement learning approaches, are typically centralized and assume static objectives, making them slow to adapt when preferences shift. We propose a dynamic and fully distributed multi-objective Q-learning routing algorithm that learns multiple per-preference Q-tables in parallel and introduces a novel greedy interpolation policy to act near-optimally for unseen preferences without retraining or central coordination. A theoretical analysis further shows that the optimal value function is Lipschitz-continuous in the preference parameter, ensuring that the proposed greedy interpolation policy yields provably near-optimal behavior. Simulations show that our approach adapts in real time to shifting priorities and achieves up to 80-90\% lower energy consumption and more than 2-5x higher cumulative rewards and packet delivery compared to six baseline protocols, under dynamic and distributed settings. Sensitivity analysis across varying preference window lengths confirms that the proposed DPQ framework consistently achieves higher composite reward than all baseline methods, demonstrating robustness to changes in operating conditions.

title: Enabling Training-Free Semantic Communication Systems with Generative Diffusion Models
summary: Semantic communication (SemCom) has recently emerged as a promising paradigm for next-generation wireless systems. Empowered by advanced artificial intelligence (AI) technologies, SemCom has achieved significant improvements in transmission quality and efficiency. However, existing SemCom systems either rely on training over large datasets and specific channel conditions or suffer from performance degradation under channel noise when operating in a training-free manner. To address these issues, we explore the use of generative diffusion models (GDMs) as training-free SemCom systems. Specifically, we design a semantic encoding and decoding method based on the inversion and sampling process of the denoising diffusion implicit model (DDIM), which introduces a two-stage forward diffusion process, split between the transmitter and receiver to enhance robustness against channel noise. Moreover, we optimize sampling steps to compensate for the increased noise level caused by channel noise. We also conduct a brief analysis to provide insights about this design. Simulations on the Kodak dataset validate that the proposed system outperforms the existing baseline SemCom systems across various metrics.

title: Grasp the Graph (GtG) 2.0: Ensemble of Graph Neural Networks for High-Precision Grasp Pose Detection in Clutter
summary: Grasp pose detection in cluttered, real-world environments remains a significant challenge due to noisy and incomplete sensory data combined with complex object geometries. This paper introduces Grasp the Graph 2.0 (GtG 2.0) method, a lightweight yet highly effective hypothesis-and-test robotics grasping framework which leverages an ensemble of Graph Neural Networks for efficient geometric reasoning from point cloud data. Building on the success of GtG 1.0, which demonstrated the potential of Graph Neural Networks for grasp detection but was limited by assumptions of complete, noise-free point clouds and 4-Dof grasping, GtG 2.0 employs a conventional Grasp Pose Generator to efficiently produce 7-Dof grasp candidates. Candidates are assessed with an ensemble Graph Neural Network model which includes points within the gripper jaws (inside points) and surrounding contextual points (outside points). This improved representation boosts grasp detection performance over previous methods using the same generator. GtG 2.0 shows up to a 35% improvement in Average Precision on the GraspNet-1Billion benchmark compared to hypothesis-and-test and Graph Neural Network-based methods, ranking it among the top three frameworks. Experiments with a 3-Dof Delta Parallel robot and Kinect-v1 camera show a success rate of 91% and a clutter completion rate of 100%, demonstrating its flexibility and reliability.

title: seq-JEPA: Autoregressive Predictive Learning of Invariant-Equivariant World Models
summary: Joint-embedding self-supervised learning (SSL) commonly relies on transformations such as data augmentation and masking to learn visual representations, a task achieved by enforcing invariance or equivariance with respect to these transformations applied to two views of an image. This dominant two-view paradigm in SSL often limits the flexibility of learned representations for downstream adaptation by creating performance trade-offs between high-level invariance-demanding tasks such as image classification and more fine-grained equivariance-related tasks. In this work, we propose \emph{seq-JEPA}, a world modeling framework that introduces architectural inductive biases into joint-embedding predictive architectures to resolve this trade-off. Without relying on dual equivariance predictors or loss terms, seq-JEPA simultaneously learns two architecturally separate representations for equivariance- and invariance-demanding tasks. To do so, our model processes short sequences of different views (observations) of inputs. Each encoded view is concatenated with an embedding of the relative transformation (action) that produces the next observation in the sequence. These view-action pairs are passed through a transformer encoder that outputs an aggregate representation. A predictor head then conditions this aggregate representation on the upcoming action to predict the representation of the next observation. Empirically, seq-JEPA demonstrates strong performance on both equivariance- and invariance-demanding downstream tasks without sacrificing one for the other. Furthermore, it excels at tasks that inherently require aggregating a sequence of observations, such as path integration across actions and predictive learning across eye movements.

title: SRAF: Stealthy and Robust Adversarial Fingerprint for Copyright Verification of Large Language Models
summary: The protection of Intellectual Property (IP) for Large Language Models (LLMs) has become a critical concern as model theft and unauthorized commercialization escalate. While adversarial fingerprinting offers a promising black-box solution for ownership verification, existing methods suffer from significant limitations: they are fragile against model modifications, sensitive to system prompt variations, and easily detectable due to high-perplexity input patterns. In this paper, we propose SRAF, which employs a multi-task adversarial optimization strategy that jointly optimizes fingerprints across homologous model variants and diverse chat templates, allowing the fingerprint to anchor onto invariant decision boundary features. Furthermore, we introduce a Perplexity Hiding technique that embeds adversarial perturbations within Markdown tables, effectively aligning the prompt's statistics with natural language to evade perplexity-based detection. Experiments on Llama-2 variants demonstrate SRAF's superior robustness and stealthiness compared to state-of-the-art baselines, offering a practical black-box solution for ownership verification.

title: PsOCR: Benchmarking Large Multimodal Models for Optical Character Recognition in Low-resource Pashto Language
summary: This paper evaluates the performance of Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) on Optical Character Recognition (OCR) in the low-resource Pashto language. Natural Language Processing (NLP) in Pashto faces several challenges due to the cursive nature of its script and a scarcity of structured datasets. To address this, we developed a synthetic Pashto OCR dataset, PsOCR, consisting of one million images annotated with bounding boxes at word, line, and document levels, suitable for training and evaluating models based on different architectures, including Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Transformers. PsOCR covers variations across 1,000 unique font families, colors, image sizes, and layouts. A benchmark subset of 10K images was selected to evaluate the performance of several LMMs, including seven open-source models: DeepSeek's Janus, InternVL, MiniCPM, Florence, and Qwen (3B and 7B), and four closed-source models: GPT-4o, Gemini, Claude, and Grok. Experimental results demonstrate that Gemini achieves the best performance among all models, whereas among open-source models, Qwen-7B stands out. This work provides an insightful assessment of the capabilities and limitations of current LMMs for OCR tasks in Pashto and establishes a foundation for further research not only in Pashto OCR but also for other similar scripts such as Arabic, Persian, and Urdu. PsOCR is available at https://github.com/zirak-ai/PashtoOCR.

title: Streamlining evidence based clinical recommendations with large language models
summary: Clinical evidence underpins informed healthcare decisions, yet integrating it into real-time practice remains challenging due to intensive workloads, complex procedures, and time constraints. This study presents Quicker, an LLM-powered system that automates evidence synthesis and generates clinical recommendations following standard guideline development workflows. Quicker delivers an end-to-end pipeline from clinical questions to recommendations and supports customized decision-making through integrated tools and interactive interfaces. To evaluate how closely Quicker can reproduce guideline development processes, we constructed Q2CRBench-3, a benchmark derived from guideline development records for three diseases. Experiments show that Quicker produces precise question decomposition, expert-aligned retrieval, and near-comprehensive screening. Quicker assistance improved the accuracy of extracted study data, and its recommendations were more comprehensive and coherent than clinician-written ones. In system-level testing, Quicker working with one participant reduced recommendation development to 20-40 min. Overall, the findings demonstrate Quicker's potential to enhance the speed and reliability of evidence-based clinical decision-making.

title: SelfBudgeter: Adaptive Token Allocation for Efficient LLM Reasoning
summary: Recently, large reasoning models demonstrate exceptional performance on various tasks. However, reasoning models always consume excessive tokens even for simple queries, leading to resource waste and prolonged user latency. To address this challenge, we propose SelfBudgeter - a self-adaptive reasoning strategy for efficient and controllable reasoning. Specifically, we first train the model to self-estimate the required reasoning budget based on the query. We then introduce budget-guided GPRO for reinforcement learning, which effectively maintains accuracy while reducing output length. Experimental results demonstrate that SelfBudgeter dynamically allocates budgets according to problem complexity, achieving an average response length compression of 61% on math reasoning tasks while maintaining accuracy. Furthermore, SelfBudgeter allows users to see how long generation will take and decide whether to continue or stop. Additionally, users can directly control the reasoning length by setting token budgets upfront.

title: PartDexTOG: Generating Dexterous Task-Oriented Grasping via Language-driven Part Analysis
summary: Task-oriented grasping is a crucial yet challenging task in robotic manipulation. Despite the recent progress, few existing methods address task-oriented grasping with dexterous hands. Dexterous hands provide better precision and versatility, enabling robots to perform task-oriented grasping more effectively. In this paper, we argue that part analysis can enhance dexterous grasping by providing detailed information about the object's functionality. We propose PartDexTOG, a method that generates dexterous task-oriented grasps via language-driven part analysis. Taking a 3D object and a manipulation task represented by language as input, the method first generates the category-level and part-level grasp descriptions w.r.t the manipulation task by LLMs. Then, a category-part conditional diffusion model is developed to generate a dexterous grasp for each part, respectively, based on the generated descriptions. To select the most plausible combination of grasp and corresponding part from the generated ones, we propose a measure of geometric consistency between grasp and part. We show that our method greatly benefits from the open-world knowledge reasoning on object parts by LLMs, which naturally facilitates the learning of grasp generation on objects with different geometry and for different manipulation tasks. Our method ranks top on the OakInk-shape dataset over all previous methods, improving the Penetration Volume, the Grasp Displace, and the P-FID over the state-of-the-art by $3.58\%$, $2.87\%$, and $41.43\%$, respectively. Notably, it demonstrates good generality in handling novel categories and tasks.

title: TF-Mamba: Text-enhanced Fusion Mamba with Missing Modalities for Robust Multimodal Sentiment Analysis
summary: Multimodal Sentiment Analysis (MSA) with missing modalities has attracted increasing attention recently. While current Transformer-based methods leverage dense text information to maintain model robustness, their quadratic complexity hinders efficient long-range modeling and multimodal fusion. To this end, we propose a novel and efficient Text-enhanced Fusion Mamba (TF-Mamba) framework for robust MSA with missing modalities. Specifically, a Text-aware Modality Enhancement (TME) module aligns and enriches non-text modalities, while reconstructing the missing text semantics. Moreover, we develop Text-based Context Mamba (TC-Mamba) to capture intra-modal contextual dependencies under text collaboration. Finally, Text-guided Query Mamba (TQ-Mamba) queries text-guided multimodal information and learns joint representations for sentiment prediction. Extensive experiments on three MSA datasets demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of the proposed method under missing modality scenarios. Our code is available at https://github.com/codemous/TF-Mamba.

title: Graph-Guided Passage Retrieval for Author-Centric Structured Feedback
summary: Obtaining high-quality, pre-submission feedback is a critical bottleneck in the academic publication lifecycle for researchers. We introduce AutoRev, an automated author-centric feedback system that generates structured, actionable guidance prior to formal peer review. AutoRev employs a graph-based retrieval-augmented generation framework that models each paper as a hierarchical document graph, integrating textual and structural representations to retrieve salient content efficiently. By leveraging graph-based passage retrieval, AutoRev substantially reduces LLM input context length, leading to higher-quality feedback generation. Experimental results demonstrate that AutoRev significantly outperforms baselines across multiple automatic evaluation metrics, while achieving strong performance in human evaluations. Code will be released upon acceptance.

title: The Computational Complexity of Counting Linear Regions in ReLU Neural Networks
comments: 26 pages, 6 figures, paper accepted at NeurIPS 2025. v3: Update to Fig. 1
summary: An established measure of the expressive power of a given ReLU neural network is the number of linear regions into which it partitions the input space. There exist many different, non-equivalent definitions of what a linear region actually is. We systematically assess which papers use which definitions and discuss how they relate to each other. We then analyze the computational complexity of counting the number of such regions for the various definitions. Generally, this turns out to be an intractable problem. We prove NP- and #P-hardness results already for networks with one hidden layer and strong hardness of approximation results for two or more hidden layers. Finally, on the algorithmic side, we demonstrate that counting linear regions can at least be achieved in polynomial space for some common definitions.
comment: 26 pages, 6 figures, paper accepted at NeurIPS 2025. v3: Update to Fig. 1

title: Advanced Long-term Earth System Forecasting
summary: Reliable long-term forecasting of Earth system dynamics is fundamentally limited by instabilities in current artificial intelligence (AI) models during extended autoregressive simulations. These failures often originate from inherent spectral bias, leading to inadequate representation of critical high-frequency, small-scale processes and subsequent uncontrolled error amplification. Inspired by the nested grids in numerical models used to resolve small scales, we present TritonCast. At the core of its design is a dedicated latent dynamical core, which ensures the long-term stability of the macro-evolution at a coarse scale. An outer structure then fuses this stable trend with fine-grained local details. This design effectively mitigates the spectral bias caused by cross-scale interactions. In atmospheric science, it achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on the WeatherBench 2 benchmark while demonstrating exceptional long-term stability: executing year-long autoregressive global forecasts and completing multi-year climate simulations that span the entire available $2500$-day test period without drift. In oceanography, it extends skillful eddy forecast to $120$ days and exhibits unprecedented zero-shot cross-resolution generalization. Ablation studies reveal that this performance stems from the synergistic interplay of the architecture's core components. TritonCast thus offers a promising pathway towards a new generation of trustworthy, AI-driven simulations. This significant advance has the potential to accelerate discovery in climate and Earth system science, enabling more reliable long-term forecasting and deeper insights into complex geophysical dynamics.

title: Let Me Think! A Long Chain-of-Thought Can Be Worth Exponentially Many Short Ones
summary: Inference-time computation has emerged as a promising scaling axis for improving large language model reasoning. However, despite yielding impressive performance, the optimal allocation of inference-time computation remains poorly understood. A central question is whether to prioritize sequential scaling (e.g., longer chains of thought) or parallel scaling (e.g., majority voting across multiple short chains of thought). In this work, we seek to illuminate the landscape of test-time scaling by demonstrating the existence of reasoning settings where sequential scaling offers an exponential advantage over parallel scaling. These settings are based on graph connectivity problems in challenging distributions of graphs. We validate our theoretical findings with comprehensive experiments across a range of language models, including models trained from scratch for graph connectivity with different chain of thought strategies as well as large reasoning models.

title: Local cubic spline interpolation for Vlasov-type equations on a multi-patch geometry
summary: We present a semi-Lagrangian method for the numerical resolution of Vlasov-type equations on multi-patch meshes. Following N. Crouseilles et al. [A parallel Vlasov solver based on local cubic spline interpolation on patches. Journal of Computational Physics (2009)], we employ a local cubic spline interpolation with Hermite boundary conditions between the patches. The derivative reconstruction is adapted to cope with non-uniform meshes as well as non-conforming situations. In the conforming case, there are no longer any constraints on the number of points for each patch; however, a small global system must now be solved. In that case, the local spline representations coincide with the corresponding global spline reconstruction. Alternatively, we can choose not to apply the global system and the derivatives can be approximated. The influence of the most distant points diminishes as the number of points per patch increases. For uniform per patch configurations, a study of the explicit and asymptotic behavior of this influence has been led. The method is validated using a two-dimensional guiding-center model with an O-point. All the numerical results are carried out in the Gyselalib++ library.

title: VietMix: A Naturally-Occurring Parallel Corpus and Augmentation Framework for Vietnamese-English Code-Mixed Machine Translation
summary: Machine translation (MT) systems universally degrade when faced with code-mixed text. This problem is more acute for low-resource languages that lack dedicated parallel corpora. This work directly addresses this gap for Vietnamese-English, a language context characterized by challenges including orthographic ambiguity and the frequent omission of diacritics in informal text. We introduce VietMix, the first expert-translated, naturally occurring parallel corpus of Vietnamese-English code-mixed text. We establish VietMix's utility by developing a data augmentation pipeline that leverages iterative fine-tuning and targeted filtering. Experiments show that models augmented with our data outperform strong back-translation baselines by up to +3.5 xCOMET points and improve zero-shot models by up to +11.9 points. Our work delivers a foundational resource for a challenging language pair and provides a validated, transferable framework for building and augmenting corpora in other low-resource settings.

title: Guiding Generative Storytelling with Knowledge Graphs
comments: Accepted for publication in the International Journal of Human-Computer Interaction. Published online 29 December 2025
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown great potential in story generation, but challenges remain in maintaining long-form coherence and effective, user-friendly control. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) has proven effective in reducing hallucinations in text generation; while knowledge-graph (KG)-driven storytelling has been explored in prior work, this work focuses on KG-assisted long-form generation and an editable KG coupled with LLM generation in a two-stage user study. This work investigates how KGs can enhance LLM-based storytelling by improving narrative quality and enabling user-driven modifications. We propose a KG-assisted storytelling pipeline and evaluate it in a user study with 15 participants. Participants created prompts, generated stories, and edited KGs to shape their narratives. Quantitative and qualitative analysis finds improvements concentrated in action-oriented, structurally explicit narratives under our settings, but not for introspective stories. Participants reported a strong sense of control when editing the KG, describing the experience as engaging, interactive, and playful.
comment: Accepted for publication in the International Journal of Human-Computer Interaction. Published online 29 December 2025

title: Let's Put Ourselves in Sally's Shoes: Shoes-of-Others Prefilling Improves Theory of Mind in Large Language Models
summary: Recent studies have shown that Theory of Mind (ToM) in large language models (LLMs) has not reached human-level performance yet. Since fine-tuning LLMs on ToM datasets often degrades their generalization, several inference-time methods have been proposed to enhance ToM in LLMs. However, existing inference-time methods for ToM are specialized for inferring beliefs from contexts involving changes in the world state. In this study, we present a new inference-time method for ToM, Shoes-of-Others (SoO) prefilling, which makes fewer assumptions about contexts and is applicable to broader scenarios. SoO prefilling simply specifies the beginning of LLM outputs with ``Let's put ourselves in A's shoes.'', where A denotes the target character's name. We evaluate SoO prefilling on two benchmarks that assess ToM in conversational and narrative contexts without changes in the world state and find that it consistently improves ToM across five categories of mental states. Our analysis suggests that SoO prefilling elicits faithful thoughts, thereby improving the ToM performance.

AI.title_translation: 让我们设身处地为莎莉着想：他人视角预填充提升大型语言模型的“心智理论”能力
AI.tldr: 一种名为“他人视角预填充”的简单提示工程方法（即“让我们设身处地为A着想”）显著提升了大型语言模型的“心智理论”能力，且无需进行微调。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型的“心智理论”（ToM）尚未达到人类水平，且针对ToM数据集进行微调会损害其泛化能力。现有的推理时方法过于专业化，仅适用于涉及世界状态变化的上下文，需要一种更通用、假设更少的推理时方法。
AI.method: 提出了一种新的推理时方法：“他人视角”（SoO）预填充。该方法假设更少，适用场景更广。它通过在LLM输出的开头指定“让我们设身处地为A着想”（A为目标角色名称）来实现。
AI.result: 在两个评估ToM的基准测试上进行了评估（这两个基准测试涉及对话和叙事上下文，且不包含世界状态变化）。结果显示，SoO预填充在五类心理状态上一致地提升了ToM性能。分析表明，SoO预填充引发了忠实的思考。
AI.conclusion: 他人视角预填充是一种简单、通用且有效的推理时方法，通过引导大型语言模型产生忠实的思考，从而显著提升其心智理论能力。
AI.translation: 最近的研究表明，大型语言模型（LLMs）的“心智理论”（ToM）尚未达到人类水平。鉴于在ToM数据集上对LLMs进行微调通常会降低其泛化能力，因此已经提出了几种推理时方法来增强LLMs的ToM。然而，现有的ToM推理时方法专门用于从涉及世界状态变化的上下文中推断信念。在本研究中，我们提出了一种新的ToM推理时方法：“他人视角”（SoO）预填充，它对上下文的假设更少，适用于更广泛的场景。SoO预填充只是简单地将LLM输出的开头指定为“让我们设身处地为A着想”，其中A表示目标角色的名称。我们在两个评估对话和叙事上下文中ToM的基准测试上对SoO预填充进行了评估，这些基准测试不涉及世界状态的变化，结果发现该方法在五类心理状态上持续提升了ToM能力。我们的分析表明，SoO预填充引发了忠实的思考，从而改善了ToM性能。
AI.summary: 针对大型语言模型（LLM）心智理论（ToM）表现不足且现有推理时方法过于局限的问题，本文提出了一种名为“他人视角”（SoO）预填充的新型推理时方法。该方法通过在模型输出前添加“让我们设身处地为A着想”的简单提示，使其适用于更广泛的场景。实验证明，SoO预填充在不涉及世界状态变化的对话和叙事上下文中，能持续提升LLM在五类心理状态上的ToM表现，其机制在于引导模型产生更忠实的思考。
AI.keywords: 心智理论, 大型语言模型, 推理时方法, 预填充, 提示工程
AI.comments: 本研究的创新点在于提出了一种极其简单且通用的推理时方法——“他人视角预填充”，以解决LLM心智理论的局限性。与需要复杂上下文假设的现有方法或损害泛化能力的微调方法相比，这种基于简单提示工程的技术提供了一个有效且鲁棒的解决方案，尤其适用于更广泛的、不涉及世界状态变化的场景。

title: Machine learning for in-situ composition mapping in a self-driving magnetron sputtering system
comments: 24 pages, 10 figures. Submitted to the journal npj computational materials
summary: Self-driving labs (SDLs), employing automation and machine learning (ML) to accelerate experimental procedures, have enormous potential in the discovery of new materials. However, in thin film science, SDLs are mainly restricted to solution-based synthetic methods which are easier to automate but cannot access the broad chemical space of inorganic materials. This work presents an SDL based on magnetron co-sputtering. We are using combinatorial frameworks, obtaining accurate composition maps on multi-element, compositionally graded thin films. This normally requires time-consuming ex-situ analysis prone to systematic errors. We present a rapid and calibration-free in-situ, ML driven approach to produce composition maps for arbitrary source combinations and sputtering conditions. We develop a method to predict the composition distribution in a multi-element combinatorial thin film, using in-situ measurements from quartz-crystal microbalance sensors placed in a sputter chamber. For a given source, the sensor readings are learned as a function of the sputtering pressure and magnetron power, through active learning using Gaussian processes (GPs). The final GPs are combined with a geometric model of the deposition flux distribution in the chamber, which allows interpolation of the deposition rates from each source, at any position across the sample. We investigate several acquisition functions for the ML procedure. A fully Bayesian GP - BALM (Bayesian active learning MacKay) - achieved the best performance, learning the deposition rates for a single source in 10 experiments. Prediction accuracy for co-sputtering composition distributions was verified experimentally. Our framework dramatically increases throughput by avoiding the need for extensive characterisation or calibration, thus demonstrating the potential of ML-guided SDLs to accelerate materials exploration.

AI.title_translation: 用于自驱动磁控溅射系统中原位成分图谱的机器学习
AI.tldr: 开发了一个基于磁控共溅射的自驱动实验室（SDL），利用高斯过程（GPs）和主动学习，结合石英晶体微天平（QCM）的传感器读数，实现了快速、免校准的原位薄膜成分图谱绘制，仅需10次实验即可学习沉积速率，显著提高了材料探索的效率。
AI.motivation: 现有的自驱动实验室（SDLs）主要局限于溶液合成方法，难以触及无机材料的广阔化学空间。薄膜科学中常用的组分映射分析耗时且容易出错（异位分析）。
AI.method: 建立了一个基于磁控共溅射的SDL系统。利用腔室内的石英晶体微天平（QCM）传感器进行原位测量，并使用高斯过程（GPs）的主动学习来建模传感器读数与溅射压力和磁控管功率之间的关系。最终将学习到的GPs与沉积通量分布的几何模型结合，以插值出样品上任意位置的沉积速率，从而预测多元素薄膜的成分分布。
AI.result: 该方法实现了共溅射成分分布的准确预测（经过实验验证）。其中，完全贝叶斯GP模型——BALM（Bayesian active learning MacKay）表现最佳，仅用10次实验就学习了单个源的沉积速率。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过避免大量的表征或校准需求，极大地提高了实验效率和吞吐量，从而展示了ML指导的SDL在加速材料探索方面的巨大潜力。
AI.translation: 自驱动实验室（SDLs）利用自动化和机器学习（ML）来加速实验过程，在新材料的发现中具有巨大的潜力。然而，在薄膜科学中，SDLs主要局限于溶液合成方法，这些方法虽然更易于自动化，但无法触及无机材料的广阔化学空间。这项工作提出了一个基于磁控共溅射的SDL。我们使用组合框架，在多元素、成分梯度薄膜上获得准确的成分图谱。这通常需要耗时的异位分析，且容易产生系统误差。我们提出了一种快速、免校准的原位、ML驱动的方法，用于生成任意源组合和溅射条件下的成分图谱。我们开发了一种方法，利用放置在溅射腔室中的石英晶体微天平传感器获得的现场测量数据，来预测多元素组合薄膜中的成分分布。对于给定的源，通过使用高斯过程（GPs）的主动学习，传感器读数被学习为溅射压力和磁控管功率的函数。最终的GPs与腔室中沉积通量分布的几何模型相结合，从而可以在样品上的任何位置插值出每个源的沉积速率。我们研究了几种用于ML过程的采集函数。一个完全贝叶斯GP——BALM（Bayesian active learning MacKay）——取得了最好的性能，在10次实验中学习了单个源的沉积速率。共溅射成分分布的预测准确性得到了实验验证。我们的框架通过避免对大量表征或校准的需求，极大地提高了吞吐量，从而展示了ML引导的SDL加速材料探索的潜力。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一个基于磁控共溅射的自驱动实验室（SDL）框架，旨在克服现有SDL在薄膜科学和无机材料探索中的局限性。该方法利用放置在溅射腔室内的石英晶体微天平（QCM）传感器进行原位测量，并结合高斯过程（GPs）的主动学习，来快速、免校准地预测多元素组合薄膜的成分分布。实验结果显示，最优的贝叶斯主动学习模型（BALM）仅需10次实验即可学习单个源的沉积速率，并准确验证了共溅射成分分布的预测精度。该框架显著提高了材料探索的效率和吞吐量。
AI.keywords: 自驱动实验室, 磁控溅射, 机器学习, 原位成分图谱, 高斯过程
AI.comments: 这项工作的创新性在于将自驱动实验室（SDL）的概念成功扩展到传统的薄膜沉积方法——磁控溅射，这对于探索广阔的无机材料化学空间至关重要。通过集成原位传感器（QCM）和先进的机器学习（主动学习与高斯过程），该系统实现了免校准和高吞吐量的成分映射，极大地加速了材料研发周期。特别是，仅用10次实验就能准确学习沉积速率，展示了主动学习在减少昂贵实验次数方面的强大能力。

title: Bridging External and Parametric Knowledge: Mitigating Hallucination of LLMs with Shared-Private Semantic Synergy in Dual-Stream Knowledge
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) aims to mitigate the hallucination of Large Language Models (LLMs) by retrieving and incorporating relevant external knowledge into the generation process. However, the external knowledge may contain noise and conflict with the parametric knowledge of LLMs, leading to degraded performance. Current LLMs lack inherent mechanisms for resolving such conflicts. To fill this gap, we propose a Dual-Stream Knowledge-Augmented Framework for Shared-Private Semantic Synergy (DSSP-RAG). Central to it is the refinement of the traditional self-attention into a mixed-attention that distinguishes shared and private semantics for a controlled knowledge integration. An unsupervised hallucination detection method that captures the LLMs' intrinsic cognitive uncertainty ensures that external knowledge is introduced only when necessary. To reduce noise in external knowledge, an Energy Quotient (EQ), defined by attention difference matrices between task-aligned and task-misaligned layers, is proposed. Extensive experiments show that DSSP-RAG achieves a superior performance over strong baselines.

AI.title_translation: 弥合外部知识与参数知识：在双流知识中利用共享-私有语义协同来减轻大型语言模型的幻觉
AI.tldr: 为解决RAG中外部知识与LLM参数知识的冲突及噪声问题，本文提出了DSSP-RAG框架。该框架通过混合注意力区分共享/私有语义，实现知识的协同与受控集成；通过无监督幻觉检测按需引入外部知识；并通过能量商（EQ）过滤噪声。实验证明其性能优越。
AI.motivation: RAG旨在减轻LLM的幻觉，但外部知识可能包含噪声并与参数知识冲突，导致性能下降。当前的LLMs缺乏解决这些冲突的内在机制。
AI.method: 提出DSSP-RAG（双流知识增强框架用于共享-私有语义协同）。其核心方法包括：1. 将传统自注意力改进为混合注意力，以区分共享和私有语义，实现受控的知识集成。2. 采用捕获LLM内在认知不确定性的无监督幻觉检测方法，确保仅在必要时引入外部知识。3. 定义能量商（EQ，基于任务对齐和错位层间的注意力差异矩阵）来减少外部知识中的噪声。
AI.result: 广泛的实验表明，DSSP-RAG取得了优于强大基线模型的性能。
AI.translation: 检索增强生成（RAG）旨在通过检索并将相关外部知识纳入生成过程来减轻大型语言模型（LLMs）的幻觉。然而，外部知识可能包含噪声并与LLMs的参数知识冲突，导致性能下降。当前的LLMs缺乏解决此类冲突的内在机制。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了一个用于共享-私有语义协同的双流知识增强框架（DSSP-RAG）。其核心是将传统的自注意力改进为混合注意力，以区分共享和私有语义，从而实现受控的知识集成。一种捕获LLMs内在认知不确定性的无监督幻觉检测方法，确保仅在必要时引入外部知识。为了减少外部知识中的噪声，我们提出了一个能量商（EQ），它由任务对齐层和任务错位层之间的注意力差异矩阵定义。广泛的实验表明，DSSP-RAG取得了优于强大基线模型的性能。
AI.summary: 本文提出了DSSP-RAG框架，旨在通过解决外部知识与LLM参数知识之间的冲突和噪声问题，来减轻RAG中LLM的幻觉。DSSP-RAG的核心是采用混合注意力机制来区分和协同共享与私有语义，实现知识的受控整合。此外，它结合了基于内在认知不确定性的无监督幻觉检测机制来决定何时引入外部知识，并使用基于注意力差异矩阵的能量商（EQ）来过滤外部知识中的噪声。实验证明DSSP-RAG优于现有基线。
AI.keywords: 检索增强生成, 幻觉减轻, 双流知识, 共享-私有语义协同, 混合注意力
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了DSSP-RAG框架，通过引入“共享-私有语义协同”这一概念，并将其具体化为混合注意力机制，解决了RAG中外部知识与LLM参数知识冲突的关键问题。同时，结合了两个实用的机制：基于不确定性的按需知识引入（通过无监督幻觉检测），以及基于注意力差异的知识噪声过滤（能量商EQ），使得知识增强过程更加精细和可控。这对于提高RAG系统的可靠性、有效减轻LLM的幻觉具有重要的理论和实践价值。

title: Efficient Algorithms to Compute Closed Substrings
summary: A closed string $u$ is either of length one or contains a border that occurs only as a prefix and as a suffix in $u$ and nowhere else within $u$. In this paper, we present fast $\mathcal{O}(n\log n)$ time algorithms to compute all $\mathcal{O}(n^2)$ closed substrings by introducing a compact representation for all closed substrings of a string $ w[1..n]$, using only $\mathcal{O}(n \log n)$ space. These simple and space-efficient algorithms also compute maximal closed strings. Furthermore, we compare the performance of these algorithms and identify classes of strings where each performs best. Finally, we show that the exact number of MCSs ($M(f_n)$) in a Fibonacci word $ f_n $, for $n \geq 5$, is $\approx \left(1 + \frac{1}{φ^2}\right) F_n \approx 1.382 F_n$, where $ φ$ is the golden ratio.

AI.title_translation: 高效计算闭合子串的算法
AI.tldr: 提出了快速的 $\mathcal{O}(n\log n)$ 时间和空间的算法，用于计算字符串中的所有闭合子串和最大闭合子串（MCSs）。同时，给出了斐波那契词中MCSs数量的精确近似公式。
AI.motivation: 提高计算字符串中所有闭合子串的效率并减少空间占用，并研究最大闭合子串的特性。
AI.method: 通过引入一种紧凑表示法，仅使用 $\mathcal{O}(n \log n)$ 空间来表示字符串 $w[1..n]$ 的所有闭合子串。基于此表示法，设计了能在 $\mathcal{O}(n\log n)$ 时间内计算所有闭合子串和最大闭合子串（MCSs）的简单且空间高效的算法。此外，还对这些算法的性能进行了比较。
AI.result: 1. 成功设计了在 $\mathcal{O}(n\log n)$ 时间和 $\mathcal{O}(n \log n)$ 空间内计算所有 $\mathcal{O}(n^2)$ 闭合子串的算法。 2. 这些算法能够计算最大闭合子串（MCSs）。 3. 确定了不同算法在特定字符串类别中表现最佳的情况。 4. 证明了对于 $n \geq 5$ 的斐波那契词 $f_n$，其最大闭合子串数量 $M(f_n)$ 约为 $\left(1 + \frac{1}{\varphi^2}\right) F_n \approx 1.382 F_n$（其中 $\varphi$ 是黄金比例）。
AI.conclusion: 提供了计算闭合子串和最大闭合子串的高效 $\mathcal{O}(n\log n)$ 时间和空间算法，并为斐波那契词中的最大闭合子串数量提供了精确的近似公式。
AI.translation: 一个闭合字符串 $u$ 要么长度为一，要么包含一个边界，该边界仅作为 $u$ 的前缀和后缀出现，而在 $u$ 的其他任何地方都不出现。在本文中，我们通过引入一种紧凑表示法，仅使用 $\mathcal{O}(n \log n)$ 空间来表示字符串 $w[1..n]$ 的所有闭合子串，从而提出了快速的 $\mathcal{O}(n\log n)$ 时间算法来计算所有 $\mathcal{O}(n^2)$ 闭合子串。这些简单且空间高效的算法也能够计算最大闭合字符串。此外，我们比较了这些算法的性能，并确定了每种算法表现最佳的字符串类别。最后，我们证明了对于 $n \geq 5$ 的斐波那契词 $f_n$，其最大闭合子串（MCSs）的精确数量 $M(f_n)$ 约为 $\left(1 + \frac{1}{\varphi^2}\right) F_n \approx 1.382 F_n$，其中 $\varphi$ 是黄金比例。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一类高效的 $\mathcal{O}(n\log n)$ 时间算法，用于计算字符串中所有 $\mathcal{O}(n^2)$ 闭合子串。通过引入仅需 $\mathcal{O}(n \log n)$ 空间的紧凑表示法，这些算法能够同时计算最大闭合字符串（MCSs）。研究还包括对算法性能的比较分析，并得出了斐波那契词 $f_n$ 中MCSs数量的精确近似公式，即 $M(f_n) \approx 1.382 F_n$。
AI.keywords: 闭合子串, 最大闭合字符串, 紧凑表示法, 斐波那契词, 高效算法
AI.comments: 本文的主要创新在于将计算所有 $\mathcal{O}(n^2)$ 闭合子串的时间复杂度降低到高效的 $\mathcal{O}(n\log n)$，同时通过引入紧凑表示法将空间复杂度也控制在 $\mathcal{O}(n \log n)$。这种空间和时间效率的提升对于字符串算法和大规模数据处理具有重要意义。此外，对斐波那契词这一特殊字符串类别中最大闭合子串数量的精确数学分析，展示了理论研究的深度。

title: An Introduction to Solving the Least-Squares Problem in Variational Data Assimilation
summary: Variational data assimilation is a technique for combining measured data with dynamical models. It is a key component of Earth system state estimation and is commonly used in weather and ocean forecasting. The approach involves a large-scale generalized nonlinear least-squares problem. Solving the resulting sequence of sparse linear subproblems requires the use of sophisticated numerical linear algebra methods. In practical applications, the computational demands severely limit the number of iterations of a Krylov subspace solver that can be performed and so high-quality preconditioners are vital. In this paper, we present a numerical linear algebra perspective on variational data assimilation and discuss contemporary solution methods for the challenges posed by large-scale geophysical applications. The principal contribution is a focused treatment of the underlying linear algebraic subproblems, accompanied by a concise and clear introduction to the essential concepts of variational data assimilation and an extensive bibliography.

AI.title_translation: 变分数据同化中最小二乘问题的求解介绍
AI.tldr: 变分数据同化（用于天气和海洋预报的关键技术）涉及大规模非线性最小二乘问题。本文从数值线性代数的角度，重点介绍和讨论了求解这些大型地球物理应用中线性代数子问题的当代方法，强调了高质量预处理器的重要性。
AI.motivation: 变分数据同化是地球系统状态估计的关键组成部分，涉及大规模广义非线性最小二乘问题。由于计算需求严格限制了Krylov子空间求解器的迭代次数，因此在实际应用中，高质量的预处理器对于求解由此产生的稀疏线性子问题至关重要。
AI.method: 本文采用数值线性代数的视角，讨论了用于解决大规模地球物理应用中挑战的当代求解方法。主要贡献是集中处理底层的线性代数子问题，并提供变分数据同化基本概念的介绍和参考文献。
AI.translation: 变分数据同化是一种将测量数据与动力学模型相结合的技术。它是地球系统状态估计的关键组成部分，常用于天气和海洋预报。该方法涉及一个大规模的广义非线性最小二乘问题。求解由此产生的一系列稀疏线性子问题需要使用复杂的数值线性代数方法。在实际应用中，计算需求严重限制了Krylov子空间求解器可以执行的迭代次数，因此高质量的预处理器至关重要。在本文中，我们提出了一个关于变分数据同化的数值线性代数视角，并讨论了解决大规模地球物理应用所带来的挑战的当代求解方法。主要贡献是对基础线性代数子问题的集中处理，并附带对变分数据同化的基本概念的简洁明了的介绍和大量的参考文献。
AI.summary: 变分数据同化（VDA）是天气和海洋预报中结合测量数据和动力学模型的关键技术，涉及求解大规模非线性最小二乘问题。由于计算限制，求解这些问题中的稀疏线性子问题时，高质量的预处理器对于Krylov子空间求解器至关重要。本文从数值线性代数的角度，介绍了VDA的基本概念，并集中讨论了解决大型地球物理应用中底层线性代数子问题的当代方法。
AI.keywords: 变分数据同化, 最小二乘问题, 数值线性代数, 预处理器, Krylov子空间
AI.comments: 这篇论文旨在为从事变分数据同化（VDA）的地球科学研究人员提供一个重要的桥梁，连接VDA应用与高性能数值线性代数方法。其创新性在于将计算瓶颈（即求解大规模稀疏线性子问题）置于核心位置，并强调预处理技术的重要性。对于需要提高VDA系统效率和可扩展性的实践者来说，这是一个基础且关键的资源，特别是对于解决大规模地球物理应用中的计算挑战具有重要指导意义。

title: Multi-GPU Acceleration of PALABOS Fluid Solver using C++ Standard Parallelism
summary: This article presents the principles, software architecture, and performance analysis of the GPU port of the lattice Boltzmann software library Palabos (J. Latt et al., "Palabos: Parallel lattice Boltzmann solver", Comput. Math. Appl. 81, 334-350, (2021)). A hybrid CPU-GPU execution model is adopted, in which numerical components are selectively assigned to either the CPU or the GPU, depending on considerations of performance or convenience. This design enables a progressive porting strategy, allowing most features of the original CPU-based codebase to be gradually and seamlessly adapted to GPU execution. The new architecture builds upon two complementary paradigms: a classical object-oriented structure for CPU execution, and a data-oriented counterpart for GPUs, which reproduces the modularity of the original code while eliminating object-oriented overhead detrimental to GPU performance. Central to this approach is the use of modern C++, including standard parallel algorithms and template metaprogramming techniques, which permit the generation of hardware-agnostic computational kernels. This facilitates the development of user-defined, GPU-accelerated components such as collision operators or boundary conditions, while preserving compatibility with the existing codebase and avoiding the need for external libraries or non-standard language extensions. The correctness and performance of the GPU-enabled Palabos are demonstrated through a series of three-dimensional multiphysics benchmarks, including the laminar-turbulent transition in a Taylor-Green vortex, lid-driven cavity flow, and pore-scale flow in Berea sandstone. Despite the high-level abstraction of the implementation, the single-GPU performance is similar to CUDA-native solvers, and multi-GPU tests exhibit good weak and strong scaling across all test cases.

AI.title_translation: 使用C++标准并行性的PALABOS流体求解器的多GPU加速
AI.tldr: 介绍了一种使用现代C++标准并行性和模板元编程技术，将Palabos格子玻尔兹曼流体求解器移植到混合CPU-GPU架构的方法。该方法实现了与原生CUDA求解器相当的单GPU性能，并在多GPU测试中表现出良好的扩展性，同时避免了使用外部库。
AI.motivation: 对格子玻尔兹曼软件库Palabos进行GPU移植，以实现加速和性能提升，同时保留原有CPU代码库的大部分功能并实现平稳过渡。
AI.method: 采用混合CPU-GPU执行模型，根据性能和便利性选择性地分配数值组件。架构基于两种互补范式：CPU使用经典的面向对象结构；GPU使用数据导向结构，以消除对GPU性能不利的面向对象开销。核心技术是使用现代C++（包括标准并行算法和模板元编程），以生成硬件无关的计算内核，从而避免对外部库或非标准语言扩展的依赖。
AI.result: 通过一系列三维多物理场基准测试（包括Taylor-Green涡流的层流-湍流过渡、盖驱动腔流和Berea砂岩中的孔隙尺度流）证明了正确性和性能。尽管实现具有高层次抽象，但单GPU性能与CUDA原生求解器相似，并且多GPU测试在所有测试案例中都表现出良好的弱扩展性和强扩展性。
AI.translation: 本文介绍了格子玻尔兹曼软件库Palabos（J. Latt et al., "Palabos: Parallel lattice Boltzmann solver", Comput. Math. Appl. 81, 334-350, (2021)）的GPU移植的原理、软件架构和性能分析。文中采用了混合CPU-GPU执行模型，其中数值组件根据性能或便利性考虑，选择性地分配给CPU或GPU。这种设计实现了渐进式移植策略，允许原有基于CPU的代码库的大部分功能逐步且无缝地适应GPU执行。新架构建立在两个互补范式之上：用于CPU执行的经典面向对象结构，以及用于GPU的面向数据对应结构，后者在消除不利于GPU性能的面向对象开销的同时，重现了原始代码的模块化。这种方法的关键在于使用现代C++，包括标准并行算法和模板元编程技术，从而能够生成硬件无关的计算内核。这有助于开发用户定义的、GPU加速的组件，例如碰撞算子或边界条件，同时保持与现有代码库的兼容性，并避免对外部库或非标准语言扩展的需求。通过一系列三维多物理场基准测试，包括Taylor-Green涡流中的层流-湍流过渡、盖驱动腔流以及Berea砂岩中的孔隙尺度流，证明了启用GPU的Palabos的正确性和性能。尽管实现具有高层次抽象，但单GPU性能与CUDA原生求解器相似，并且多GPU测试在所有测试案例中都表现出良好的弱扩展性和强扩展性。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了格子玻尔兹曼求解器Palabos的混合CPU-GPU移植及其软件架构。该移植利用现代C++的标准并行性和模板元编程，构建了一个结合面向对象（CPU）和面向数据（GPU）的架构，以实现渐进式移植并消除GPU上的性能开销。这种方法生成了硬件无关的内核，避免了外部库依赖，并允许用户轻松定义GPU加速组件。性能测试显示，该实现与原生CUDA求解器性能相当，并在多GPU配置中展示了良好的弱扩展性和强扩展性。
AI.keywords: 格子玻尔兹曼, 多GPU加速, C++标准并行性, 混合CPU-GPU, Palabos
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于成功地将一个复杂的、基于CPU的流体求解器（Palabos）移植到多GPU环境，同时避免了对专有并行框架（如CUDA或OpenCL）的直接依赖。通过智能地结合面向对象（CPU）和面向数据（GPU）范式，并利用C++标准并行性，它提供了一个高度抽象、灵活且硬件无关的加速解决方案。这对于希望利用异构计算但又希望保持代码库可移植性和模块化的科学计算社区具有重要意义。性能结果表明，高层次的C++抽象并不必然牺牲性能，其性能可与原生实现相媲美。

title: A First Look at Bugs in LLM Inference Engines
comments: Accepted by ACM Transactions on Software Engineering and Methodology
summary: Large language model-specific inference engines (in short as \emph{LLM inference engines}) have become a fundamental component of modern AI infrastructure, enabling the deployment of LLM-powered applications (LLM apps) across cloud and local devices. Despite their critical role, LLM inference engines are prone to bugs due to the immense resource demands of LLMs and the complexities of cross-platform compatibility. However, a systematic understanding of these bugs remains lacking. To bridge this gap, we present the first empirical study on bugs in LLM inference engines. We mine official repositories of 5 widely adopted LLM inference engines, constructing a comprehensive dataset of 929 real-world bugs. Through a rigorous open coding process, we analyze these bugs to uncover their symptoms, root causes, commonality, fix effort, fix strategies, and temporal evolution. Our findings reveal six bug symptom types and a taxonomy of 28 root causes, shedding light on the key challenges in bug detection and location within LLM inference engines. Based on these insights, we propose a series of actionable implications for researchers, inference engine vendors, and LLM app developers, along with general guidelines for developing LLM inference engines.
comment: Accepted by ACM Transactions on Software Engineering and Methodology

AI.title_translation: 首次探究LLM推理引擎中的错误
AI.tldr: 研究人员首次深入分析了LLM推理引擎中的929个错误，发现了六种症状和28种根本原因，为提高这些关键AI基础设施的可靠性提供了实用建议。
AI.motivation: LLM推理引擎是现代AI部署的基础，但由于LLM巨大的资源需求和跨平台兼容性的复杂性，它们容易出现错误。然而，对这些错误的系统性理解仍然缺乏，需要进行实证研究来填补这一空白。
AI.method: 通过挖掘5个广泛采用的LLM推理引擎的官方代码库，构建了一个包含929个真实世界错误的综合数据集。然后，通过严格的开放编码过程，分析了这些错误的症状、根本原因、普遍性、修复工作量、修复策略和时间演变。
AI.result: 研究发现了六种错误症状类型和28种根本原因的分类，揭示了在LLM推理引擎中进行错误检测和定位的关键挑战。
AI.conclusion: 基于对错误的深入分析，研究提出了针对研究人员、推理引擎供应商和LLM应用开发者的可操作的建议，以及开发LLM推理引擎的总体指南。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型特定的推理引擎（简称“LLM推理引擎”）已成为现代人工智能基础设施的基本组成部分，使得LLM驱动的应用（LLM应用）能够在云端和本地设备上部署。尽管它们扮演着关键角色，但由于LLM巨大的资源需求和跨平台兼容性的复杂性，LLM推理引擎容易出现错误。然而，对这些错误的系统性理解仍然缺乏。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了首次对LLM推理引擎中错误的实证研究。我们挖掘了5个广泛采用的LLM推理引擎的官方代码库，构建了一个包含929个真实世界错误的综合数据集。通过严格的开放编码过程，我们分析了这些错误的症状、根本原因、普遍性、修复工作量、修复策略和时间演变。我们的研究结果揭示了六种错误症状类型和28种根本原因的分类，阐明了LLM推理引擎中错误检测和定位的关键挑战。基于这些见解，我们为研究人员、推理引擎供应商和LLM应用开发者提出了一系列可操作的启示，以及开发LLM推理引擎的总体指南。

title: Generative or Discriminative? Revisiting Text Classification in the Era of Transformers
comments: 23 pages - received Outstanding Paper award at EMNLP 2025
summary: The comparison between discriminative and generative classifiers has intrigued researchers since Efron's seminal analysis of logistic regression versus discriminant analysis. While early theoretical work established that generative classifiers exhibit lower sample complexity but higher asymptotic error in simple linear settings, these trade-offs remain unexplored in the transformer era. We present the first comprehensive evaluation of modern generative and discriminative architectures - Auto-regressive modeling, Masked Language Modeling, Discrete Diffusion, and Encoders for text classification. Our study reveals that the classical 'two regimes' phenomenon manifests distinctly across different architectures and training paradigms. Beyond accuracy, we analyze sample efficiency, calibration, noise robustness, and ordinality across diverse scenarios. Our findings offer practical guidance for selecting the most suitable modeling approach based on real-world constraints such as latency and data limitations.

AI.title_translation: 生成式还是判别式？在 Transformer 时代重新审视文本分类
AI.tldr: 本文对 Transformer 时代的文本分类任务中，现代生成式（如自回归、掩码语言模型、离散扩散）和判别式（如编码器）架构进行了首次全面比较，分析了它们在准确性、样本效率和鲁棒性等方面的表现，并提供了实际选择指导。
AI.motivation: 尽管生成式与判别式分类器的比较是一个经典议题（可追溯到 Efron 的开创性分析），但这些权衡（如较低的样本复杂度和较高的渐近误差）在 Transformer 时代仍未得到探索。
AI.method: 首次对现代生成式（自回归建模、掩码语言建模、离散扩散）和判别式（编码器）架构在文本分类任务中的应用进行了全面评估。研究涵盖了准确性、样本效率、校准、噪声鲁棒性和有序性等多个维度。
AI.result: 经典的“两种机制”（two regimes）现象在不同的架构和训练范式中表现出明显的差异。
AI.conclusion: 我们的发现为根据延迟和数据限制等实际约束条件选择最合适的建模方法提供了实用指导。
AI.translation: 自 Efron 对逻辑回归与判别分析进行开创性分析以来，判别式分类器与生成式分类器之间的比较一直吸引着研究人员。虽然早期的理论工作确定了生成式分类器在简单的线性设置中表现出较低的样本复杂度但较高的渐近误差，但在 Transformer 时代，这些权衡仍未得到探索。我们首次对现代生成式和判别式架构——自回归建模、掩码语言建模、离散扩散和编码器——在文本分类任务中的应用进行了全面评估。我们的研究揭示了经典的“两种机制”现象在不同的架构和训练范式中表现出明显的差异。除了准确性之外，我们还分析了在不同场景下的样本效率、校准、噪声鲁棒性和有序性。我们的发现为根据延迟和数据限制等实际约束条件选择最合适的建模方法提供了实用指导。
AI.summary: 本文重新探讨了 Transformer 时代文本分类中的生成式和判别式模型的经典权衡问题。研究首次全面比较了四种现代架构（自回归、掩码语言模型、离散扩散和编码器），分析了它们在准确性、样本效率、校准和鲁棒性等多个指标上的表现。结果证实，经典的“两种机制”现象依然存在，但其表现形式取决于具体的架构和训练方法。研究结论旨在为实际应用中模型选择提供指导，以应对延迟和数据限制等现实挑战。
AI.keywords: 生成式分类器, 判别式分类器, 文本分类, Transformer, 样本效率
AI.comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于，它将一个经典的机器学习理论问题（生成式 vs. 判别式）置于当前最先进的深度学习范式——Transformer 架构——中进行重新审视和量化。其重要性在于，它为实践者提供了关于不同预训练目标（自回归、掩码语言模型、离散扩散）和架构（编码器）在下游任务（文本分类）中实际性能、效率和鲁棒性权衡的实证数据，填补了该领域的一个关键空白。

title: Branch, or Layer? Zeroth-Order Optimization for Continual Learning of Vision-Language Models
comments: Published in the Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence (AAAI 2026)
summary: Vision-Language Continual Learning (VLCL) has attracted significant research attention for its robust capabilities, and the adoption of Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) strategies is enabling these models to achieve competitive performance with substantially reduced resource consumption. However, dominated First-Order (FO) optimization is prone to trap models in suboptimal local minima, especially in limited exploration subspace within PEFT. To overcome this challenge, this paper pioneers a systematic exploration of adopting Zeroth-Order (ZO) optimization for PEFT-based VLCL. We first identify the incompatibility of naive full-ZO adoption in VLCL due to optimization process instability. We then investigate the application of ZO optimization from a modality branch-wise to a fine-grained layer-wise across various training units to identify an optimal strategy. Besides, a key theoretical insight reveals that vision modality exhibit higher variance than language counterparts in VLCL during the ZO optimization process, and we propose a modality-aware ZO strategy, which adopts gradient sign normalization in ZO and constrains vision modality perturbation to further improve performance. Benefiting from the adoption of ZO optimization, PEFT-based VLCL fulfills better ability to escape local minima during the optimization process, extensive experiments on four benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art results.
comment: Published in the Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence (AAAI 2026)

AI.title_translation: 分支还是层？视觉-语言模型的持续学习的零阶优化
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种新的零阶（ZO）优化方法，用于解决视觉-语言持续学习（VLCL）中参数高效微调（PEFT）模型容易陷入局部最优的问题。研究发现，直接采用ZO优化不稳定，并提出了一种逐层或逐分支的优化策略，以及一种考虑视觉和语言模态差异的自适应ZO方法，最终在四个基准测试中取得了最先进的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉-语言持续学习（VLCL）方法主要采用一阶（FO）优化，容易在参数高效微调（PEFT）的有限探索子空间中陷入局部最优。因此，需要一种新的优化方法来克服这一挑战。
AI.method: 本文首次系统地将零阶（ZO）优化应用于基于PEFT的VLCL。研究了从模态分支到细粒度层级的不同ZO优化策略，并提出了一种模态感知的ZO策略，通过梯度符号归一化和约束视觉模态扰动来提高性能。
AI.result: 所提出的基于ZO优化的方法，在PEFT-based VLCL中能够更好地跳出局部最优。在四个基准测试上的大量实验表明，该方法取得了最先进的结果。
AI.conclusion: 零阶（ZO）优化，特别是通过模态感知的策略，能够有效地解决视觉-语言持续学习（VLCL）中参数高效微调（PEFT）模型容易陷入局部最优的问题，并在多个基准测试中实现了最先进的性能。
AI.translation: 视觉-语言持续学习（VLCL）因其强大的能力而引起了广泛的研究关注，参数高效微调（PEFT）策略的应用使得这些模型能够以大大降低的资源消耗实现具有竞争力的性能。然而，占主导地位的一阶（FO）优化容易将模型困在次优的局部最小值，尤其是在PEFT有限的探索子空间内。为了克服这一挑战，本文开创性地系统探索了将零阶（ZO）优化应用于基于PEFT的VLCL。我们首先发现直接采用ZO优化在VLCL中存在不稳定性问题。然后，我们研究了从模态分支到细粒度层级的ZO优化应用，以确定最佳策略。此外，一个关键的理论见解揭示了在ZO优化过程中，视觉模态比语言模态在VLCL中表现出更高的方差，我们提出了一种模态感知的ZO策略，该策略在ZO中采用梯度符号归一化，并约束视觉模态扰动以进一步提高性能。受益于ZO优化的采用，基于PEFT的VLCL在优化过程中能够更好地跳出局部最小值，在四个基准测试上的广泛实验表明，我们的方法取得了最先进的结果。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种新颖的零阶（ZO）优化方法，用于解决参数高效微调（PEFT）在视觉-语言持续学习（VLCL）中容易陷入局部最优的问题。研究人员通过分析发现，直接应用ZO优化存在不稳定性，并提出了一种逐层或逐分支的优化策略。此外，他们还提出了一种模态感知的ZO策略，通过梯度符号归一化和约束视觉模态扰动来进一步提升性能。实验结果表明，该方法在四个基准测试中均取得了最先进的性能。
AI.keywords: 视觉-语言持续学习, 参数高效微调, 零阶优化, 局部最小值, 模态感知
AI.comments: 这项研究在视觉-语言持续学习领域引入了零阶优化，解决了一阶优化在参数高效微调中容易陷入局部最优的痛点。通过提出模态感知的策略，该方法在理论和实践上都具有创新性。然而，零阶优化的计算成本可能较高，这可能是其在实际应用中的一个潜在局限性。

title: Probing Deep into Temporal Profile Makes the Infrared Small Target Detector Much Better
summary: Infrared small target (IRST) detection is challenging in simultaneously achieving precise, robust, and efficient performance due to extremely dim targets and strong interference. Current learning-based methods attempt to leverage ``more" information from both the spatial and the short-term temporal domains, but suffer from unreliable performance under complex conditions while incurring computational redundancy. In this paper, we explore the ``more essential" information from a more crucial domain for the detection. Through theoretical analysis, we reveal that the global temporal saliency and correlation information in the temporal profile demonstrate significant superiority in distinguishing target signals from other signals. To investigate whether such superiority is preferentially leveraged by well-trained networks, we built the first prediction attribution tool in this field and verified the importance of the temporal profile information. Inspired by the above conclusions, we remodel the IRST detection task as a one-dimensional signal anomaly detection task, and propose an efficient deep temporal probe network (DeepPro) that only performs calculations in the time dimension for IRST detection. We conducted extensive experiments to fully validate the effectiveness of our method. The experimental results are exciting, as our DeepPro outperforms existing state-of-the-art IRST detection methods on widely-used benchmarks with extremely high efficiency, and achieves a significant improvement on dim targets and in complex scenarios. We provide a new modeling domain, a new insight, a new method, and a new performance, which can promote the development of IRST detection. Codes are available at https://github.com/TinaLRJ/DeepPro.

title: Dense 3D Displacement Estimation for Landslide Monitoring via Fusion of TLS Point Clouds and Embedded RGB Images
comments: Published in the International Journal of Applied Earth Observation and Geoinformation. 25 pages, 19 figures
summary: Landslide monitoring is essential for understanding geohazards and mitigating associated risks. Existing point cloud-based methods, however, typically rely on either geometric or radiometric information and often yield sparse or non-3D displacement estimates. In this paper, we propose a hierarchical partitioning-based coarse-to-fine approach that integrates 3D point clouds and co-registered RGB images to estimate dense 3D displacement vector fields. Patch-level matches are constructed using both 3D geometry and 2D image features, refined via geometric consistency checks, and followed by rigid transformation estimation per match. Experimental results on two real-world landslide datasets demonstrate that the proposed method produces 3D displacement estimates with high spatial coverage (79% and 97%) and accuracy. Deviations in displacement magnitude with respect to external measurements (total station or GNSS observations) are 0.15 m and 0.25 m on the two datasets, respectively, and only 0.07 m and 0.20 m compared to manually derived references, all below the mean scan resolutions (0.08 m and 0.30 m). Compared with the state-of-the-art method F2S3, the proposed approach improves spatial coverage while maintaining comparable accuracy. The proposed approach offers a practical and adaptable solution for TLS-based landslide monitoring and is extensible to other types of point clouds and monitoring tasks. The example data and source code are publicly available at https://github.com/gseg-ethz/fusion4landslide.
