title: AttriCtrl: Fine-Grained Control of Aesthetic Attribute Intensity in Diffusion Models
summary: Diffusion models have recently become the dominant paradigm for image generation, yet existing systems struggle to interpret and follow numeric instructions for adjusting semantic attributes. In real-world creative scenarios, especially when precise control over aesthetic attributes is required, current methods fail to provide such controllability. This limitation partly arises from the subjective and context-dependent nature of aesthetic judgments, but more fundamentally stems from the fact that current text encoders are designed for discrete tokens rather than continuous values. Meanwhile, efforts on aesthetic alignment, often leveraging reinforcement learning, direct preference optimization, or architectural modifications, primarily align models with a global notion of human preference. While these approaches improve user experience, they overlook the multifaceted and compositional nature of aesthetics, underscoring the need for explicit disentanglement and independent control of aesthetic attributes. To address this gap, we introduce AttriCtrl, a lightweight framework for continuous aesthetic intensity control in diffusion models. It first defines relevant aesthetic attributes, then quantifies them through a hybrid strategy that maps both concrete and abstract dimensions onto a unified $[0,1]$ scale. A plug-and-play value encoder is then used to transform user-specified values into model-interpretable embeddings for controllable generation. Experiments show that AttriCtrl achieves accurate and continuous control over both single and multiple aesthetic attributes, significantly enhancing personalization and diversity. Crucially, it is implemented as a lightweight adapter while keeping the diffusion model frozen, ensuring seamless integration with existing frameworks such as ControlNet at negligible computational cost.

title: Prompt Injection Vulnerability of Consensus Generating Applications in Digital Democracy
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are gaining traction as a method to generate consensus statements and aggregate preferences in digital democracy experiments. Yet, LLMs could introduce critical vulnerabilities in these systems. Here, we examine the vulnerability and robustness of off-the-shelf consensus-generating LLMs to prompt-injection attacks, in which texts are injected to amplify particular viewpoints, erase certain opinions, or divert consensus toward unrelated or irrelevant topics. We construct attack-free and adversarial variants of prompts containing public policy questions and opinion texts, classify opinion and consensus valences with a fine-tuned BERT model, and estimate Attack Success Rates (ASR) from $3\times3$ confusion matrices conditional on matching human majorities. Across topics, default LLaMA 3.1 8B Instruct, GPT-4.1 Nano, and Apertus 8B exhibit widespread vulnerability, with especially high ASR for economically and socially conservative parties and for rational, instruction-like rhetorical strategies. A robustness pipeline combining GPT-OSS-SafeGuard injection detection, structured opinion representations, and GSPO-based reinforcement learning reduces ASR to near zero across parties and policy clusters when restricting attention to non-ambiguous consensus outcomes. These findings advance our understanding of both the vulnerabilities and the potential defenses of consensus-generating LLMs in digital democracy applications.

title: Expert Preference-based Evaluation of Automated Related Work Generation
summary: Expert domain writing, such as scientific writing, typically demands extensive domain knowledge. Although large language models (LLMs) show promising potential in this task, evaluating the quality of automatically generated scientific writing is a crucial open issue, as it requires knowledge of domain-specific criteria and the ability to discern expert preferences. Conventional task-agnostic automatic evaluation metrics and LLM-as-a-judge systems, primarily designed for mainstream NLP tasks, are insufficient to grasp expert preferences and domain-specific quality standards. To address this gap and support realistic human-AI collaborative writing, we focus on related work generation, one of the most challenging scientific tasks, as an exemplar. We propose GREP, a multi-turn evaluation framework that integrates classical related work evaluation criteria with expert-specific preferences. Our framework decomposes the evaluation into smaller fine-grained dimensions. This localized evaluation is further augmented with contrastive examples to provide detailed contextual guidance for the evaluation dimensions. Empirical investigation reveals that our framework is able to assess the quality of related work sections in a much more robust manner compared to standard LLM judges, reflects natural scenarios of scientific writing, and bears a strong correlation with the assessment of human experts. We also observe that generations from state-of-the-art (SoTA) LLMs struggle to satisfy validation constraints of a suitable related work section.

title: Symbolic Planning and Multi-Agent Path Finding in Extremely Dense Environments with Unassigned Agents
summary: We introduce the Block Rearrangement Problem (BRaP), a challenging component of large warehouse management which involves rearranging storage blocks within dense grids to achieve a goal state. We formally define the BRaP as a graph search problem. Building on intuitions from sliding puzzle problems, we propose five search-based solution algorithms, leveraging joint configuration space search, classical planning, multi-agent pathfinding, and expert heuristics. We evaluate the five approaches empirically for plan quality and scalability. Despite the exponential relation between search space size and block number, our methods demonstrate efficiency in creating rearrangement plans for deeply buried blocks in up to 80x80 grids.

title: RumorSphere: A Framework for Million-scale Agent-based Dynamic Simulation of Rumor Propagation
summary: Rumor propagation modeling is critical for understanding and mitigating misinformation. Existing approaches combining rule-based regular agents with LLM-driven core agents provide a promising paradigm for large-scale rumor simulation. However, overlooking the dynamic nature of core agents and the importance of network topology on rumor spread significantly undermines the simulation performance. To address these issues, we present RumorSphere, a dynamic and hierarchical resonance framework for effective rumor simulation at the million-agent scale. Considering the dynamic role of core agents in rumor evolution, we propose a multi-agent dynamic interaction strategy based on the information cocoon theory, which adaptively identifies and activates critical core agents at conflict boundaries using LLMs, effectively supporting simulations with millions of agents. In addition, we design a hierarchical resonance network that integrates opinion leaders and localized community structures, enabling more realistic modeling of explosive rumor spread in real-world scenarios. Experiments on real-world datasets show that RumorSphere outperforms state-of-the-art methods, reducing simulation bias by an average of 26.5%.

title: Card Sorting with Fewer Cards and the Same Mental Models? A Re-examination of an Established Practice
comments: accepted for publication in International Journal of Human-Computer Interaction
summary: To keep card sorting with a lot of cards concise, a common strategy for gauging mental models involves presenting participants with fewer randomly selected cards instead of the full set. This is a decades-old practice, but its effects lacked systematic examination. To assess how randomized subsets affect data, we conducted an experiment with 160 participants. We compared results between full and randomized 60\% card sets, then analyzed sample size requirements and the impacts of individual personality and cognitive factors. Our results demonstrate that randomized subsets can yield comparable similarity matrices to standard card sorting, but thematic patterns in categories can differ. Increased data variability also warrants larger sample sizes (25-35 for 60% card subset). Results indicate that personality traits and cognitive reflection interact with card sorting. Our research suggests evidence-based practices for conducting card sorting while exposing the influence of study design and individual differences on measurement of mental models.
comment: accepted for publication in International Journal of Human-Computer Interaction

title: Rethinking Supply Chain Planning: A Generative Paradigm
summary: Supply chain planning is the critical process of anticipating future demand and coordinating operational activities across the logistics network. However, within the context of contemporary e-commerce, traditional planning paradigms, typically characterized by fragmented processes and static optimization, prove inadequate in addressing dynamic demand, organizational silos, and the complexity of multi-stage coordination. To address these challenges, this study proposes a fundamental rethinking of supply chain planning, redefining it not merely as a computational task, but as an interactive, integrated, and automated cognitive process. This new paradigm emphasizes the organic unification of human strategic intent with adaptive execution, shifting the focus from rigid control to continuous, intelligent orchestration. To operationalize this conceptual shift, we introduce a Generative AI-powered agentic framework. Functioning as an intelligent cognitive interface, this framework bridges the gap between unstructured business contexts and structured analytical workflows, enabling the system to comprehend complex semantics and coordinate decisions across organizational boundaries. We demonstrate the empirical validity of this approach within JD.com's large-scale operations. The deployment confirms the efficacy of this cognitive paradigm, yielding an approximate 22% improvement in planning accuracy and a 2% increase in in-stock rates, thereby validating the transformation of planning into an adaptive, knowledge-driven capability.

title: MAGneT: Coordinated Multi-Agent Generation of Synthetic Multi-Turn Mental Health Counseling Sessions
summary: The growing demand for scalable psychological counseling highlights the need for high-quality, privacy-compliant data, yet such data remains scarce. Here we introduce MAGneT, a novel multi-agent framework for synthetic psychological counseling session generation that decomposes counselor response generation into coordinated sub-tasks handled by specialized LLM agents, each modeling a key psychological technique. Unlike prior single-agent approaches, MAGneT better captures the structure and nuance of real counseling. We further propose a unified evaluation framework that consolidates diverse automatic metrics and expands expert assessment from four to nine counseling dimensions, thus addressing inconsistencies in prior evaluation protocols. Empirically, MAGneT substantially outperforms existing methods: experts prefer MAGneT-generated sessions in 77.2% of cases, and sessions generated by MAGneT yield 3.2% higher general counseling skills and 4.3% higher CBT-specific skills on cognitive therapy rating scale (CTRS). A open source Llama3-8B-Instruct model fine-tuned on MAGneT-generated data also outperforms models fine-tuned using baseline synthetic datasets by 6.9% on average on CTRS.We also make our code and data public.

title: Linear time encodable binary code achieving GV bound with linear time encodable dual achieving GV bound
summary:
We initiate the study of what we term ``fast good codes'' with ``fast good duals.'' Specifically, we consider the task of constructing a rate 1/2 binary linear code such that both it and its dual are asymptotically good (in fact, have rate-distance tradeoff approaching the GV bound), and are encodable in linear time. While we believe such codes should find applications more broadly, as motivation we describe how such codes can be used the secure computation task of encrypted matrix-vector product.
  Our main contribution is a construction of such a fast good code with fast good dual. Our construction is inspired by the repeat multiple accumulate (RMA) code. To create the rate 1/2 code, after repeating each message coordinate, we perform accumulation steps -- where first a uniform coordinate permutation is applied, and afterwards the prefix-sum mod 2 is applied -- which are alternated with discrete derivative steps -- where again a uniform coordinate permutation is applied, and afterwards the previous two coordinates are summed mod 2. Importantly, these two operations are inverse of each other. In particular, the dual of the code is very similar, with the accumulation and discrete derivative steps reversed.
  Our analysis is inspired by a prior analysis of RMA: we bound the expected number of codewords of weight below the GV bound. We face new challenges in controlling the behaviour of the discrete derivative operation (which can significantly drop the weight of a vector), which we overcome by careful case analysis.

title: Spectral Masking and Interpolation Attack (SMIA): A Black-box Adversarial Attack against Voice Authentication and Anti-Spoofing Systems
summary: Voice Authentication Systems (VAS) use unique vocal characteristics for verification. They are increasingly integrated into high-security sectors such as banking and healthcare. Despite their improvements using deep learning, they face severe vulnerabilities from sophisticated threats like deepfakes and adversarial attacks. The emergence of realistic voice cloning complicates detection, as systems struggle to distinguish authentic from synthetic audio. While anti-spoofing countermeasures (CMs) exist to mitigate these risks, many rely on static detection models that can be bypassed by novel adversarial methods, leaving a critical security gap. To demonstrate this vulnerability, we propose the Spectral Masking and Interpolation Attack (SMIA), a novel method that strategically manipulates inaudible frequency regions of AI-generated audio. By altering the voice in imperceptible zones to the human ear, SMIA creates adversarial samples that sound authentic while deceiving CMs. We conducted a comprehensive evaluation of our attack against state-of-the-art (SOTA) models across multiple tasks, under simulated real-world conditions. SMIA achieved a strong attack success rate (ASR) of at least 82% against combined VAS/CM systems, at least 97.5% against standalone speaker verification systems, and 100% against countermeasures. These findings conclusively demonstrate that current security postures are insufficient against adaptive adversarial attacks. This work highlights the urgent need for a paradigm shift toward next-generation defenses that employ dynamic, context-aware frameworks capable of evolving with the threat landscape.

title: Memorization in Large Language Models in Medicine: Prevalence, Characteristics, and Implications
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated significant potential in medicine, with many studies adapting them through continued pre-training or fine-tuning on medical data to enhance domain-specific accuracy and safety. However, a key open question remains: to what extent do LLMs memorize medical training data. Memorization can be beneficial when it enables LLMs to retain valuable medical knowledge during domain adaptation. Yet, it also raises concerns. LLMs may inadvertently reproduce sensitive clinical content (e.g., patient-specific details), and excessive memorization may reduce model generalizability, increasing risks of misdiagnosis and making unwarranted recommendations. These risks are further amplified by the generative nature of LLMs, which can not only surface memorized content but also produce overconfident, misleading outputs that may hinder clinical adoption. In this work, we present a study on memorization of LLMs in medicine, assessing its prevalence (how frequently it occurs), characteristics (what is memorized), volume (how much content is memorized), and potential downstream impacts (how memorization may affect medical applications). We systematically analyze common adaptation scenarios: (1) continued pretraining on medical corpora, (2) fine-tuning on standard medical benchmarks, and (3) fine-tuning on real-world clinical data, including over 13,000 unique inpatient records from Yale New Haven Health System. The results demonstrate that memorization is prevalent across all adaptation scenarios and significantly higher than that reported in the general domain. Moreover, memorization has distinct characteristics during continued pre-training and fine-tuning, and it is persistent: up to 87% of content memorized during continued pre-training remains after fine-tuning on new medical tasks.

title: Confidence-gated training for efficient early-exit neural networks
summary: Early-exit neural networks reduce inference cost by enabling confident predictions at intermediate layers. However, joint training often leads to gradient interference, with deeper classifiers dominating optimization. We propose Confidence-Gated Training (CGT), a paradigm that conditionally propagates gradients from deeper exits only when preceding exits fail. This encourages shallow classifiers to act as primary decision points while reserving deeper layers for harder inputs. By aligning training with the inference-time policy, CGT mitigates overthinking, improves early-exit accuracy, and preserves efficiency. Experiments on the Indian Pines and Fashion-MNIST benchmarks show that CGT lowers average inference cost while improving overall accuracy, offering a practical solution for deploying deep models in resource-constrained environments.

title: LLMs as verification oracles for Solidity
summary: Ensuring the correctness of smart contracts is critical, as even subtle flaws can lead to severe financial losses. While bug detection tools able to spot common vulnerability patterns can serve as a first line of defense, most real-world exploits and losses stem from errors in the contract business logic. Formal verification tools such as SolCMC and the Certora Prover address this challenge, but their impact remains limited by steep learning curves and restricted specification languages. Recent works have begun to explore the use of large language models (LLMs) for security-related tasks such as vulnerability detection and test generation. Yet, a fundamental question remains open: can LLMs aid in assessing the validity of arbitrary contract-specific properties? In this paper, we provide the first systematic empirical evaluation of GPT-5, a state-of-the-art reasoning LLM, in this role. We benchmark its performance on a large dataset of verification tasks, compare its outputs against those of established formal verification tools, and assess its practical effectiveness in real-world auditing scenarios. Our study combines quantitative metrics with qualitative analysis, and shows that recent reasoning-oriented LLMs - although lacking soundness guarantees - can be surprisingly effective at predicting the (in)validity of complex properties, suggesting a new frontier in the convergence of AI and formal methods for secure smart contract development and auditing.

title: ImageNet-trained CNNs are not biased towards texture: Revisiting feature reliance through controlled suppression
summary: The hypothesis that Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) are inherently texture-biased has shaped much of the discourse on feature use in deep learning. We revisit this hypothesis by examining limitations in the cue-conflict experiment by Geirhos et al. To address these limitations, we propose a domain-agnostic framework that quantifies feature reliance through systematic suppression of shape, texture, and color cues, avoiding the confounds of forced-choice conflicts. By evaluating humans and neural networks under controlled suppression conditions, we find that CNNs are not inherently texture-biased but predominantly rely on local shape features. Nonetheless, this reliance can be substantially mitigated through modern training strategies or architectures (ConvNeXt, ViTs). We further extend the analysis across computer vision, medical imaging, and remote sensing, revealing that reliance patterns differ systematically: computer vision models prioritize shape, medical imaging models emphasize color, and remote sensing models exhibit a stronger reliance on texture. Code is available at https://github.com/tomburgert/feature-reliance.

title: Reflect3r: Single-View 3D Stereo Reconstruction Aided by Mirror Reflections
comments: 3DV 2026. Code and Data Available at https://jingwu2121.github.io/reflect3r/
summary: Mirror reflections are common in everyday environments and can provide stereo information within a single capture, as the real and reflected virtual views are visible simultaneously. We exploit this property by treating the reflection as an auxiliary view and designing a transformation that constructs a physically valid virtual camera, allowing direct pixel-domain generation of the virtual view while adhering to the real-world imaging process. This enables a multi-view stereo setup from a single image, simplifying the imaging process, making it compatible with powerful feed-forward reconstruction models for generalizable and robust 3D reconstruction. To further exploit the geometric symmetry introduced by mirrors, we propose a symmetric-aware loss to refine pose estimation. Our framework also naturally extends to dynamic scenes, where each frame contains a mirror reflection, enabling efficient per-frame geometry recovery. For quantitative evaluation, we provide a fully customizable synthetic dataset of 16 Blender scenes, each with ground-truth point clouds and camera poses. Extensive experiments on real-world data and synthetic data are conducted to illustrate the effectiveness of our method.
comment: 3DV 2026. Code and Data Available at https://jingwu2121.github.io/reflect3r/

title: FS-DFM: Fast and Accurate Long Text Generation with Few-Step Diffusion Language Models
summary: Autoregressive language models (ARMs) deliver strong likelihoods, but are inherently serial: they generate one token per forward pass, which limits throughput and inflates latency for long sequences. Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) parallelize across positions and thus appear promising for language generation, yet standard discrete diffusion typically needs hundreds to thousands of model evaluations to reach high quality, trading serial depth for iterative breadth. We introduce FS-DFM, Few-Step Discrete Flow-Matching. A discrete flow-matching model designed for speed without sacrificing quality. The core idea is simple: make the number of sampling steps an explicit parameter and train the model to be consistent across step budgets, so one big move lands where many small moves would. We pair this with a reliable update rule that moves probability in the right direction without overshooting, and with strong teacher guidance distilled from long-run trajectories. Together, these choices make few-step sampling stable, accurate, and easy to control. On language modeling benchmarks, FS-DFM with 8 sampling steps achieves perplexity parity with a 1,024-step discrete-flow baseline for generating 1,024 tokens using a similar-size model, delivering up to 128 times faster sampling and corresponding latency/throughput gains.

title: UPDESH: Synthesizing Grounded Instruction Tuning Data for 13 Indic
summary: Developing culturally grounded multilingual AI systems remains challenging, particularly for low-resource languages. While synthetic data offers promise, its effectiveness in multilingual and multicultural contexts is underexplored. We investigate bottom-up synthetic data generation using large open-source LLMs (>= 235B parameters) grounded in language-specific Wikipedia content, complementing dominant top-down translation-based approaches from English. We introduce Updesh, a high-quality large-scale synthetic instruction-following dataset comprising 9.5M data points across 13 Indian languages and English, encompassing diverse reasoning and generative tasks. Comprehensive evaluation using automated metrics and 10K human assessments confirms high data quality. Downstream evaluations performed by fine-tuning models on various datasets and assessing performance across 13 diverse multilingual datasets and model comparative evaluations, demonstrate that models trained on Updesh consistently obtain significant improvements on NLU, NLG evaluations. Finally, through ablation studies and cultural evaluations, we show that context-aware, culturally grounded data generation is essential for effective multilingual AI development .

title: QueryGym: Step-by-Step Interaction with Relational Databases
summary: We introduce QueryGym, an interactive environment for building, testing, and evaluating LLM-based query planning agents. Existing frameworks often tie agents to specific query language dialects or obscure their reasoning; QueryGym instead requires agents to construct explicit sequences of relational algebra operations, ensuring engine-agnostic evaluation and transparent step-by-step planning. The environment is implemented as a Gymnasium interface that supplies observations -- including schema details, intermediate results, and execution feedback -- and receives actions that represent database exploration (e.g., previewing tables, sampling column values, retrieving unique values) as well as relational algebra operations (e.g., filter, project, join). We detail the motivation and the design of the environment. In the demo, we showcase the utility of the environment by contrasting it with contemporary LLMs that query databases. QueryGym serves as a practical testbed for research in error remediation, transparency, and reinforcement learning for query generation. For the associated demo, see https://ibm.biz/QueryGym.

AI.title_translation: QueryGym：与关系数据库的逐步交互
AI.tldr: QueryGym是一个新的交互式环境，用于训练和测试基于LLM的数据库查询代理。它通过强制代理使用关系代数操作的明确步骤来保证规划的透明度和引擎无关性，并提供了一个用于错误修复和强化学习的实用测试平台。
AI.motivation: 现有的框架通常将代理与特定的查询语言方言绑定，或模糊其推理过程。
AI.method: 引入QueryGym，一个用于构建、测试和评估基于LLM的查询规划代理的交互式环境。它要求代理构建显式的关系代数操作序列，以确保与引擎无关的评估和透明的逐步规划。该环境实现为Gymnasium接口，提供观察结果（包括模式细节、中间结果、执行反馈）并接收代表数据库探索和关系代数操作的动作。
AI.result: 在演示中，通过将其与查询数据库的当代LLM进行对比，展示了该环境的实用性。（具体对比结果未提及。）
AI.conclusion: QueryGym可作为查询生成中错误修复、透明度和强化学习研究的实用试验台。
AI.translation: 我们引入了 QueryGym，这是一个用于构建、测试和评估基于大型语言模型（LLM）的查询规划代理的交互式环境。现有的框架通常将代理与特定的查询语言方言绑定，或模糊其推理过程；QueryGym 则要求代理构建显式的关系代数操作序列，从而确保与引擎无关的评估和透明的逐步规划。该环境实现为一个 Gymnasium 接口，它提供观察结果——包括模式细节、中间结果和执行反馈——并接收代表数据库探索（例如，预览表格、采样列值、检索唯一值）以及关系代数操作（例如，过滤、投影、连接）的动作。我们详细介绍了该环境的动机和设计。在演示中，我们通过将其与查询数据库的当代 LLM 进行对比，展示了该环境的实用性。QueryGym 可作为查询生成中错误修复、透明度和强化学习研究的实用试验台。相关演示请见 https://ibm.biz/QueryGym。
AI.summary: QueryGym是一个为评估基于LLM的查询规划代理而设计的交互式Gymnasium环境。与现有框架不同，QueryGym强制代理使用显式的关系代数操作序列进行逐步规划，从而提高透明度并实现与底层数据库引擎无关的评估。它通过提供详细的观察结果（如模式和中间结果）和接收探索及代数操作的动作，为错误修复、透明度研究和查询生成中的强化学习提供了一个实用的测试平台。
AI.keywords: QueryGym, LLM查询规划, 关系代数, Gymnasium, 交互式环境
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了QueryGym环境，它通过强制LLM代理使用关系代数操作序列进行查询规划，解决了现有框架中推理过程不透明和对特定查询语言方言依赖的问题。这种设计保证了评估的引擎无关性和规划的逐步透明性，为研究可解释的查询生成、错误修复和利用强化学习训练查询代理提供了一个重要且实用的标准化平台。

title: Zero-Day Audio DeepFake Detection via Retrieval Augmentation and Profile Matching
summary: Modern audio deepfake detectors built on foundation models and large training datasets achieve promising detection performance. However, they struggle with zero-day attacks, where the audio samples are generated by novel synthesis methods that models have not seen from reigning training data. Conventional approaches fine-tune the detector, which can be problematic when prompt response is needed. This paper proposes a training-free retrieval-augmented framework for zero-day audio deepfake detection that leverages knowledge representations and voice profile matching. Within this framework, we propose simple yet effective retrieval and ensemble methods that reach performance comparable to supervised baselines and their fine-tuned counterparts on the DeepFake-Eval-2024 benchmark, without any additional model training. We also conduct ablation on voice profile attributes, and demonstrate the cross-database generalizability of the framework with introducing simple and training-free fusion strategies.

AI.title_translation: 零日音频深度伪造检测：基于检索增强和配置文件匹配
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需训练的检索增强框架，用于零日音频深度伪造检测。该框架利用知识表示和声纹匹配，在不进行模型微调的情况下，实现了与监督基线相当的性能，并展示了跨数据库的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的音频深度伪造检测器在面对零日攻击（即模型未见过的新型合成方法生成的音频样本）时表现不佳。传统的微调方法在需要即时响应时存在问题。
AI.method: 提出了一种无需训练的检索增强框架，用于零日音频深度伪造检测。该框架利用知识表示（knowledge representations）和声纹配置文件匹配（voice profile matching）。此外，还提出了简单有效的检索和集成方法，以及无需训练的融合策略来增强跨数据库的泛化性。
AI.result: 在DeepFake-Eval-2024基准测试中，该框架达到了与监督基线及其微调对应模型相当的性能，且无需额外的模型训练。同时，通过消融实验证明了声纹属性的有效性，并展示了该框架的跨数据库泛化能力。
AI.translation: 建立在基础模型和大型训练数据集上的现代音频深度伪造检测器取得了可观的检测性能。然而，它们在零日攻击中表现不佳，即音频样本是由模型未曾见过的、新型合成方法生成的。传统的做法是微调检测器，但这在需要即时响应时可能会带来问题。本文提出了一种无需训练的检索增强框架，用于零日音频深度伪造检测，该框架利用知识表示和声纹配置文件匹配。在此框架内，我们提出了简单而有效的检索和集成方法，在不进行任何额外模型训练的情况下，在DeepFake-Eval-2024基准测试中达到了与监督基线及其微调对应模型相当的性能。我们还对声纹配置文件属性进行了消融实验，并通过引入简单且无需训练的融合策略，展示了该框架的跨数据库泛化能力。
AI.summary: 针对现有音频深度伪造检测器难以应对零日攻击和传统微调方法响应慢的问题，本文提出了一种无需训练的检索增强框架。该框架的核心是利用知识表示和声纹配置文件匹配来进行零日检测。实验结果表明，该框架结合简单的检索和集成方法，在DeepFake-Eval-2024基准测试中，无需额外训练即可实现与监督模型相当的检测性能，并具有良好的跨数据库泛化能力。
AI.keywords: 零日检测, 音频深度伪造, 检索增强, 配置文件匹配, 无需训练
AI.comments: 这项工作的创新点在于提出了一种完全无需训练（training-free）的零日检测解决方案，这对于需要快速部署和应对新型攻击的实际应用场景至关重要。通过将检测任务转化为“检索增强”和“配置文件匹配”，它有效地绕过了传统深度学习模型需要大量新数据进行微调的限制。其性能与监督基线相当的结果，突显了基于知识表示和声纹属性进行决策的有效性和鲁棒性。

title: MO-GRPO: Mitigating Reward Hacking of Group Relative Policy Optimization on Multi-Objective Problems
summary: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has been shown to be an effective algorithm when an accurate reward model is available. However, such a highly reliable reward model is not available in many real-world tasks. In this paper, we particularly focus on multi-objective settings, in which we identify that GRPO is vulnerable to reward hacking, optimizing only one of the objectives at the cost of the others. To address this issue, we propose MO-GRPO, an extension of GRPO with a simple normalization method to reweight the reward functions automatically according to the variances of their values. We first show analytically that MO-GRPO ensures that all reward functions contribute evenly to the loss function while preserving the order of preferences, eliminating the need for manual tuning of the reward functions' scales. Then, we evaluate MO-GRPO experimentally in four domains: (i) the multi-armed bandits problem, (ii) simulated control task (Mo-Gymnasium), (iii) machine translation tasks on the WMT benchmark (En-Ja, En-Zh), and (iv) instruction following task. MO-GRPO achieves stable learning by evenly distributing correlations among the components of rewards, outperforming GRPO, showing MO-GRPO to be a promising algorithm for multi-objective reinforcement learning problems.

AI.title_translation: MO-GRPO：缓解多目标问题上群组相对策略优化中的奖励作弊
AI.tldr: 针对多目标设置下GRPO的奖励作弊问题，本文提出了MO-GRPO，它使用基于方差的归一化方法自动重新加权奖励函数，确保所有目标均匀贡献，实现稳定学习并优于GRPO。
AI.motivation: 现有的群组相对策略优化（GRPO）算法在缺乏可靠奖励模型的多目标设置中，容易出现奖励作弊（Reward Hacking）问题，即算法牺牲其他目标来过度优化其中一个目标。
AI.method: 提出了MO-GRPO，它是GRPO的扩展，采用一种简单的归一化方法，根据奖励函数值的方差自动重新加权奖励函数。该方法在分析上保证了所有奖励函数对损失函数的贡献均衡，同时保留了偏好顺序，消除了手动调整奖励函数尺度的需要。
AI.result: MO-GRPO通过均匀分布奖励组件之间的相关性，实现了稳定的学习，并在多臂老虎机、模拟控制、机器翻译和指令遵循等四种任务域中表现优于GRPO。
AI.conclusion: MO-GRPO是一种很有前景的多目标强化学习算法，它通过均匀分布奖励组件之间的相关性，实现了稳定的学习。
AI.translation: 群组相对策略优化（GRPO）在具备准确奖励模型时已被证明是一种有效的算法。然而，在许多现实世界的任务中，这种高度可靠的奖励模型是不可得的。在本文中，我们特别关注多目标设置，我们发现GRPO容易受到奖励作弊的影响，以牺牲其他目标为代价仅优化其中一个目标。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了MO-GRPO，它是GRPO的扩展，使用一种简单的归一化方法根据奖励函数值的方差自动重新加权奖励函数。我们首先通过分析表明，MO-GRPO确保了所有奖励函数对损失函数做出均匀贡献，同时保留了偏好顺序，从而无需手动调整奖励函数的尺度。随后，我们在四个领域对MO-GRPO进行了实验评估：（i）多臂老虎机问题，（ii）模拟控制任务（Mo-Gymnasium），（iii）WMT基准测试上的机器翻译任务（英-日，英-中），以及（iv）指令遵循任务。MO-GRPO通过均匀分布奖励组件之间的相关性，实现了稳定的学习，性能优于GRPO，表明MO-GRPO是一种很有前景的多目标强化学习算法。
AI.summary: 本文提出了MO-GRPO算法，旨在缓解多目标强化学习环境中群组相对策略优化（GRPO）的奖励作弊问题。GRPO在多目标设置中倾向于过度优化单个目标。MO-GRPO通过引入基于奖励值方差的简单归一化方法，自动重新加权奖励函数，确保所有目标对优化损失的贡献均衡，同时保持偏好顺序，避免了手动调参。实验结果表明，MO-GRPO在多个领域实现了稳定学习并优于GRPO。
AI.keywords: 群组相对策略优化, 奖励作弊, 多目标, 归一化, MO-GRPO
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了MO-GRPO，它是群组相对策略优化（GRPO）针对多目标问题的扩展。关键贡献是引入了一种基于奖励值方差的简单归一化方法，解决了在多目标设置中GRPO容易出现的“奖励作弊”（Reward Hacking）问题。这种自动化权重调整机制确保了所有目标函数对损失函数的贡献均衡，同时保持了优化偏好，有效避免了手动调整奖励尺度带来的复杂性和不稳定性，显著提高了算法在复杂现实世界任务中的实用性和鲁棒性。

title: Fine-tuning Done Right in Model Editing
summary: Fine-tuning, a foundational method for adapting large language models, has long been considered ineffective for model editing. Here, we challenge this belief, arguing that the reported failure arises not from the inherent limitation of fine-tuning itself, but from adapting it to the sequential nature of the editing task, a single-pass depth-first pipeline that optimizes each sample to convergence before moving on. While intuitive, this depth-first pipeline coupled with sample-wise updating over-optimizes each edit and induces interference across edits. Our controlled experiments reveal that simply restoring fine-tuning to the standard breadth-first (i.e., epoch-based) pipeline with mini-batch optimization substantially improves its effectiveness for model editing. Moreover, fine-tuning in editing also suffers from suboptimal tuning parameter locations inherited from prior methods. Through systematic analysis of tuning locations, we derive LocFT-BF, a simple and effective localized editing method built on the restored fine-tuning framework. Extensive experiments across diverse LLMs and datasets demonstrate that LocFT-BF outperforms state-of-the-art methods by large margins. Notably, to our knowledge, it is the first to sustain 100K edits and 72B-parameter models,10 x beyond prior practice, without sacrificing general capabilities. By clarifying a long-standing misconception and introducing a principled localized tuning strategy, we advance fine-tuning from an underestimated baseline to a leading method for model editing, establishing a solid foundation for future research.

AI.title_translation: 模型编辑中的正确微调方法
AI.tldr: 微调（Fine-tuning）在模型编辑中曾被认为无效，原因在于其被错误地应用于深度优先的编辑流程。本文提出恢复标准的、基于周期的（广度优先）微调流程，并结合局部化调优策略（LocFT-BF），显著提高了编辑效果，首次实现了在不牺牲通用能力的情况下，对72B模型进行10万次编辑。
AI.motivation: 挑战长期以来关于微调在模型编辑中无效的观点。作者认为，失败的原因不在于微调本身的固有局限性，而是由于将其应用于次优的、深度优先的编辑流程，这种流程会导致编辑间的过度优化和干扰。
AI.method: 1. 将微调恢复到标准的基于周期的（广度优先）流水线和mini-batch优化。 2. 系统分析并确定最优的调优参数位置。 3. 基于此框架，提出了简单有效的局部化编辑方法 LocFT-BF。
AI.result: 1. 恢复标准的广度优先流水线显著提高了微调在模型编辑中的有效性。 2. LocFT-BF在各种LLM和数据集上均大幅优于现有最先进的方法。 3. LocFT-BF是第一个能够在不牺牲通用能力的情况下，支持10万次编辑和72B参数模型的（比现有实践高出10倍）方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过澄清一个长期存在的误解并引入一个有原则的局部化调优策略（LocFT-BF），本文将微调从一个被低估的基线提升为模型编辑中的领先方法，为未来的研究奠定了坚实的基础。
AI.translation: 微调是适应大型语言模型的基础方法，但长期以来在模型编辑中被认为无效。在本文中，我们挑战了这一观点，认为报告的失败并非源于微调本身的固有局限性，而是源于将其应用于编辑任务的顺序性质：一种单次通过的深度优先流水线，它在进入下一个样本之前，会针对当前样本优化到收敛。虽然这种方法很直观，但这种深度优先流水线与逐样本更新相结合，会导致对每次编辑的过度优化，并引起编辑间的干扰。我们的对照实验表明，简单地将微调恢复到标准的广度优先（即基于周期的）流水线并采用mini-batch优化，就能大幅提高其在模型编辑中的有效性。此外，编辑中的微调也继承了先前方法中次优的调优参数位置。通过对调优位置的系统分析，我们推导出了LocFT-BF，这是一种建立在恢复的微调框架上的、简单且有效的局部化编辑方法。跨越不同LLM和数据集的广泛实验表明，LocFT-BF大幅优于现有最先进的方法。值得注意的是，据我们所知，它是第一个在不牺牲通用能力的情况下，能够支持10万次编辑和72B参数模型（比现有实践高出10倍）的方法。通过澄清一个长期存在的误解并引入一个有原则的局部化调优策略，我们将微调从一个被低估的基线提升为模型编辑中的领先方法，为未来的研究奠定了坚实的基础。
AI.summary: 本文挑战了微调（Fine-tuning, FT）在模型编辑中无效的传统观点。作者指出，失败的原因在于将FT错误地应用于深度优先的顺序编辑流程，导致过度优化和干扰。通过将FT恢复到标准的广度优先（基于周期）流水线，并结合系统分析得出的最优参数位置，提出了LocFT-BF方法。实验证明，LocFT-BF显著优于现有SOTA方法，并首次实现了对72B模型进行10万次大规模编辑，同时保持了模型的通用能力。
AI.keywords: 微调, 模型编辑, 广度优先, LocFT-BF, 大语言模型
AI.comments: 本文的创新在于挑战了微调（FT）在模型编辑中无效的长期误解，并明确指出失败的关键在于编辑流程的结构（深度优先与广度优先）。其重要性在于将微调这一基础方法提升为模型编辑的领先技术（SOTA），具有极高的实用性和可扩展性（首次支持10万次编辑和72B模型）。LocFT-BF的提出提供了一种有原则的局部化调优策略，为未来的模型编辑研究奠定了坚实的基础。

title: SPEC-RL: Accelerating On-Policy Reinforcement Learning via Speculative Rollouts
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly rely on reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) to elicit reliable chain-of-thought reasoning. However, the training process remains bottlenecked by the computationally expensive rollout stage. Existing acceleration methods-such as parallelization, objective- and data-driven modifications, and replay buffers-either incur diminishing returns, introduce bias, or overlook redundancy across iterations. We identify that rollouts from consecutive training epochs frequently share a large portion of overlapping segments, wasting computation. To address this, we propose SPEC-RL, a novel framework that integrates SPECulative decoding with the RL rollout process. SPEC-RL reuses prior trajectory segments as speculative prefixes and extends them via a draft-and-verify mechanism, avoiding redundant generation while ensuring policy consistency. Experiments on diverse math reasoning and generalization benchmarks, including AIME24, MATH-500, OlympiadBench, MMLU-STEM, and others, demonstrate that SPEC-RL reduces rollout time by 2-3x without compromising policy quality. As a purely rollout-stage enhancement, SPEC-RL integrates seamlessly with mainstream algorithms (e.g., PPO, GRPO, DAPO), offering a general and practical path to scale RLVR for large reasoning models. Our code is available at https://github.com/ShopeeLLM/Spec-RL

AI.title_translation: SPEC-RL：通过推测性推演加速在线策略强化学习
AI.tldr: LLM的强化学习训练被昂贵的推演阶段拖慢。我们提出了SPEC-RL，通过重用前一轮的轨迹作为推测性前缀，并使用草稿-验证机制来避免重复计算，从而将推演时间减少了2-3倍，同时保持了策略质量。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）依赖带有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）来实现可靠的思维链推理。然而，训练过程受限于计算成本高昂的“推演（rollout）”阶段。现有加速方法存在收益递减、引入偏差或忽视迭代间冗余的问题。本文发现，连续训练迭代中的推演轨迹经常共享大面积的重叠片段，造成计算浪费。
AI.method: 提出了SPEC-RL框架，将推测性解码（SPECulative decoding）与RL推演过程相结合。SPEC-RL将先前的轨迹片段作为推测性前缀进行重用，并通过“草稿-验证”机制进行扩展。这种方法避免了冗余生成，同时确保了策略的一致性。
AI.result: 在包括AIME24、MATH-500、OlympiadBench、MMLU-STEM等多样化数学推理和泛化基准上的实验表明，SPEC-RL在不损害策略质量的情况下，将推演时间减少了2到3倍。作为一个纯粹的推演阶段增强方案，它可以无缝集成到主流算法（如PPO、GRPO、DAPO）中。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越依赖带有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）来引发可靠的思维链推理。然而，训练过程仍然受限于计算成本高昂的推演阶段。现有的加速方法——如并行化、基于目标和数据的修改，以及重放缓冲区——要么收益递减，要么引入偏差，要么忽视了迭代间的冗余。我们发现，连续训练迭代中的推演轨迹经常共享大面积的重叠片段，造成计算浪费。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了SPEC-RL，一个将推测性解码与RL推演过程相结合的新颖框架。SPEC-RL重用先前的轨迹片段作为推测性前缀，并通过草稿-验证机制进行扩展，从而避免了冗余生成，同时确保了策略的一致性。在包括AIME24、MATH-500、OlympiadBench、MMLU-STEM等多样化数学推理和泛化基准上的实验表明，SPEC-RL在不损害策略质量的情况下，将推演时间减少了2到3倍。作为一个纯粹的推演阶段增强方案，SPEC-RL可以与主流算法（例如PPO、GRPO、DAPO）无缝集成，为扩大大型推理模型的RLVR应用提供了一条通用且实用的途径。
AI.summary: 本文提出了SPEC-RL框架，旨在解决基于RLVR的大型语言模型训练中推演阶段计算效率低下的问题。通过识别连续训练周期中轨迹片段的重叠冗余，SPEC-RL利用推测性解码技术，将前一轮的轨迹作为推测性前缀，并结合草稿-验证机制来加速生成过程。实验证明，SPEC-RL能在不牺牲策略性能的前提下，将推演时间缩短2-3倍，并能轻松应用于现有的主流在线策略RL算法。
AI.keywords: 强化学习, 推测性推演, 在线策略RL, LLM加速, 推测性解码
AI.comments:
**创新性（Innovation）:** 本文的创新点在于将推测性解码（通常用于加速推理）创造性地应用于强化学习的训练推演阶段。它解决了在线策略RL中一个长期被忽视的效率问题：即连续策略更新之间的轨迹高度相似性所导致的重复计算。SPEC-RL的关键在于，它在加速的同时，通过“草稿-验证”机制确保了策略的一致性，避免了引入偏差，优于传统的重放缓冲区方法。

**重要性（Importance）:** 鉴于RLVR是提高LLM推理可靠性的关键技术，SPEC-RL提供了一种通用且实用的加速方案，能够有效降低RLVR的训练成本和时间，对于扩展大型推理模型的应用具有重要意义。它可以无缝集成到现有的主流算法中，具有高度的实用价值。

**局限性（Potential Limitation - based on abstract's silence）:** 抽象未提及 SPEC-RL 对内存或显存的需求变化，以及在策略差异性较大（即相邻策略快速变化）的情况下，推测性解码的效率是否会显著下降。

title: Learning How to Use Tools, Not Just When: Pattern-Aware Tool-Integrated Reasoning
summary: Tool-integrated reasoning (TIR) has become a key approach for improving large reasoning models (LRMs) on complex problems. Prior work has mainly studied when to invoke tools, while overlooking how tools are applied. We identify two common patterns: a calculator pattern that uses code for direct computation, and an algorithmic pattern that encodes problems as programs. Misaligned choices often cause failures even when reasoning is sound. We propose a two-stage framework that first builds code competence from both patterns and then aligns pattern selection with teacher preferences. Across challenging math datasets, our pattern-aware method substantially improves both code usage and accuracy, for instance raising Code@1 on MATH500 from 64.0% to 70.5% and on AIME24 from 26.7% to 50.0%. These gains highlight the effectiveness of a pattern-aware approach for tool-integrated reasoning.

AI.title_translation: 学习如何使用工具，而不仅仅是何时使用：模式感知工具集成推理
AI.tldr: 针对工具集成推理（TIR），本文提出了一种模式感知方法，区分了计算器模式和算法模式。通过两阶段框架训练模型掌握这两种模式，显著提高了复杂数学问题上的代码使用率和准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有的工具集成推理（TIR）研究主要关注“何时”调用工具，而忽略了“如何”应用工具（即工具的使用模式）。不当的模式选择是导致推理失败的关键原因。
AI.method: 提出了一种两阶段框架：第一阶段，从两种工具使用模式（计算器模式和算法模式）中建立代码能力；第二阶段，将模式选择与教师偏好对齐。
AI.result: 在具有挑战性的数学数据集上，该模式感知方法显著提高了代码使用和准确性。例如，在MATH500数据集上，Code@1从64.0%提高到70.5%；在AIME24数据集上，Code@1从26.7%提高到50.0%。
AI.conclusion: 模式感知方法对于工具集成推理是有效的，能够显著提高大型推理模型在复杂问题上的性能。
AI.translation: 工具集成推理（TIR）已成为提高大型推理模型（LRMs）解决复杂问题的关键方法。以往的工作主要研究何时调用工具，而忽略了工具是如何应用的。我们确定了两种常见模式：使用代码进行直接计算的计算器模式，以及将问题编码为程序的算法模式。即使推理过程是合理的，错误的模式选择也常常导致失败。我们提出了一个两阶段框架，首先从这两种模式中建立代码能力，然后将模式选择与教师偏好对齐。在具有挑战性的数学数据集上，我们的模式感知方法显著提高了代码使用和准确性，例如将MATH500上的Code@1从64.0%提高到70.5%，将AIME24上的Code@1从26.7%提高到50.0%。这些增益突显了模式感知方法对于工具集成推理的有效性。
AI.summary: 本文解决了工具集成推理（TIR）中被忽视的“如何使用工具”的问题。作者识别出计算器模式和算法模式这两种关键的代码使用模式，并指出模式选择不当是推理失败的原因。为此，他们提出了一个两阶段的模式感知框架，用于建立代码能力并对齐模式选择。实验结果显示，该方法在MATH和AIME等复杂数学数据集上显著提高了模型的代码使用率和推理准确性。
AI.keywords: 工具集成推理, 模式感知, 大型推理模型, 代码使用, 计算器模式
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将工具集成推理的研究焦点从传统的“何时调用”工具转移到更深层次的“如何使用”工具（即使用模式）。通过明确区分“计算器模式”和“算法模式”，并提出针对性的两阶段训练框架，有效解决了复杂推理中因模式选择错误导致的失败问题。实验结果在Code@1指标上的大幅提升，证明了模式感知方法对于提升大型推理模型实用性和可靠性的重要性。

title: TDHook: A Lightweight Framework for Interpretability
summary: Interpretability of Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) is a growing field driven by the study of vision and language models. Yet, some use cases, like image captioning, or domains like Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL), require complex modelling, with multiple inputs and outputs or use composable and separated networks. As a consequence, they rarely fit natively into the API of popular interpretability frameworks. We thus present TDHook, an open-source, lightweight, generic interpretability framework based on $\texttt{tensordict}$ and applicable to any $\texttt{torch}$ model. It focuses on handling complex composed models which can be trained for Computer Vision, Natural Language Processing, Reinforcement Learning or any other domain. This library features ready-to-use methods for attribution, probing and a flexible get-set API for interventions, and is aiming to bridge the gap between these method classes to make modern interpretability pipelines more accessible. TDHook is designed with minimal dependencies, requiring roughly half as much disk space as $\texttt{transformer_lens}$, and, in our controlled benchmark, achieves up to a $\times$2 speed-up over $\texttt{captum}$ when running integrated gradients for multi-target pipelines on both CPU and GPU. In addition, to value our work, we showcase concrete use cases of our library with composed interpretability pipelines in Computer Vision (CV) and Natural Language Processing (NLP), as well as with complex models in DRL.

AI.title_translation: TDHook：一个轻量级的可解释性框架
AI.tldr: TDHook是一个基于$\texttt{tensordict}$的轻量级、通用可解释性框架，专为处理复杂的多输入/多输出或组合式PyTorch模型设计（如DRL）。它提供了归因、探测和干预API，并且在速度（比$\texttt{captum}$快2倍）和体积（比$\texttt{transformer\_lens}$小一半）上表现出色。
AI.motivation: 现有的流行可解释性框架难以原生适配复杂模型，特别是那些具有多输入/多输出或使用可组合/分离网络的模型，例如在图像描述或深度强化学习（DRL）等领域。
AI.method: 提出了TDHook，一个开源、轻量级、通用的可解释性框架。该框架基于$\texttt{tensordict}$，适用于任何$\texttt{torch}$模型。它专注于处理计算机视觉、自然语言处理和强化学习等领域的复杂组合模型，并提供即用型的归因、探测方法以及灵活的干预get-set API。
AI.result: TDHook设计具有最少的依赖性，所需的磁盘空间约为$\texttt{transformer\_lens}$的一半。在受控基准测试中，在CPU和GPU上运行多目标管道的集成梯度时，比$\texttt{captum}$实现了高达两倍的加速。同时，通过展示了在CV、NLP和DRL中的具体用例来验证了其价值。
AI.translation: 深度神经网络（DNNs）的可解释性是一个不断发展的领域，主要由视觉和语言模型的研究驱动。然而，一些用例，如图像描述，或像深度强化学习（DRL）这样的领域，需要复杂的建模，涉及多输入和多输出，或使用可组合和分离的网络。因此，它们很少能原生适应流行可解释性框架的API。因此，我们提出了TDHook，一个基于$\texttt{tensordict}$的开源、轻量级、通用的可解释性框架，适用于任何$\texttt{torch}$模型。它专注于处理可用于计算机视觉、自然语言处理、强化学习或任何其他领域的复杂组合模型。该库具有即用型的归因、探测方法以及灵活的干预get-set API，旨在弥合这些方法类别之间的差距，使现代可解释性流程更加易于访问。TDHook设计时具有最少的依赖性，所需的磁盘空间约为$\texttt{transformer\_lens}$的一半，并且在我们受控的基准测试中，在CPU和GPU上运行多目标管道的集成梯度时，实现了比$\texttt{captum}$高达两倍的加速。此外，为了证明我们工作的价值，我们展示了该库在计算机视觉（CV）和自然语言处理（NLP）中与组合可解释性管道以及在DRL中与复杂模型的具体用例。
AI.summary: TDHook是一个针对难以适应现有流行框架API的复杂深度学习模型（如DRL中的多输入/输出或组合网络）设计的轻量级、通用可解释性框架。它基于$\texttt{tensordict}$，适用于所有$\texttt{torch}$模型，并提供归因、探测和干预的API，旨在弥合不同方法类别间的差距。该框架在性能上具有显著优势，其速度比$\texttt{captum}$快两倍，且依赖性极低，磁盘空间需求约为$\texttt{transformer\_lens}$的一半。
AI.keywords: 可解释性框架, 复杂模型, tensordict, 深度强化学习, 轻量级
AI.comments: TDHook的关键创新在于其通用性和轻量化设计，尤其针对那些在传统可解释性框架中被忽视的复杂模型结构（如DRL和组合网络）。通过利用$\texttt{tensordict}$，它提供了一个统一的接口来处理多输入/多输出的复杂数据流。其性能基准测试（速度提升和体积减小）证明了它作为现有框架替代品的实用性和效率，对于推动复杂AI领域（如DRL）的可解释性研究具有重要意义。

title: Anomaly detection for generic failure monitoring in robotic assembly, screwing and manipulation
summary: Out-of-distribution states in robot manipulation often lead to unpredictable robot behavior or task failure, limiting success rates and increasing risk of damage. Anomaly detection (AD) can identify deviations from expected patterns in data, which can be used to trigger failsafe behaviors and recovery strategies. Prior work has applied data-driven AD on time series data for specific robotic tasks, however the transferability of an AD approach between different robot control strategies and task types has not been shown. Leveraging time series data, such as force/torque signals, allows to directly capture robot-environment interactions, crucial for manipulation and online failure detection. Their broad availability, high sampling rates, and low dimensionality enable high temporal resolution and efficient processing. As robotic tasks can have widely signal characteristics and requirements, AD methods which can be applied in the same way to a wide range of tasks is needed, ideally with good data efficiency. We examine three industrial tasks, each presenting several anomalies. Test scenarios in robotic cabling, screwing, and sanding are built, and multi-modal time series data is gathered. Several autoencoder-based methods are compared, and we evaluate the generalization across different tasks and control methods (diffusion policy-, position-, and impedance-controlled). This allows us to validate the integration of AD in complex tasks involving tighter tolerances and variation from both the robot and its environment. Additionally, we evaluate data efficiency, detection latency, and task characteristics which support robust detection. The results indicate reliable detection with AUROC above 0.96 in failures in the cabling and screwing task, such as incorrect or misaligned parts. In the polishing task, only severe failures were reliably detected, while more subtle failures remained undetected.

AI.title_translation: 机器人装配、拧螺丝和操作中通用故障监测的异常检测
AI.tldr: 本文研究了基于自编码器的方法，利用多模态时间序列数据对机器人装配、拧螺丝和打磨等任务中的通用故障进行异常检测。实验表明，该方法在布线和拧螺丝任务中实现了超过0.96的可靠检测性能，但在打磨任务中对细微故障的检测效果不佳。
AI.motivation: 机器人操作中的分布外状态（out-of-distribution states）常导致不可预测的行为或任务失败，限制了成功率并增加了损坏风险。现有的数据驱动异常检测（AD）方法缺乏在不同机器人控制策略和任务类型之间的可迁移性。因此，需要一种能够以相同方式应用于广泛任务，并具有良好数据效率的通用AD方法。
AI.method: 收集了机器人布线、拧螺丝和打磨三种工业任务中的多模态时间序列数据（如力/扭矩信号）。比较了多种基于自编码器的方法，并评估了它们在不同任务和控制方法（扩散策略控制、位置控制和阻抗控制）之间的泛化能力。此外，还评估了数据效率、检测延迟和支持鲁棒检测的任务特性。
AI.result: 在布线和拧螺丝任务的故障检测中（例如零件不正确或未对准），实现了超过0.96的可靠检测AUROC。在抛光（打磨）任务中，只有严重故障能够被可靠检测，而更细微的故障仍未被检测到。
AI.conclusion: 摘要中未提及明确的结论，但实验验证了AD在涉及更严格公差的复杂任务中的集成，并在两种任务中表现可靠，同时指出了处理细微故障的挑战。
AI.translation: 机器人操作中的分布外状态通常会导致不可预测的机器人行为或任务失败，限制了成功率并增加了损坏风险。异常检测（AD）可以识别数据中与预期模式的偏差，可用于触发故障保护行为和恢复策略。先前的工作已将数据驱动的AD应用于特定机器人任务的时间序列数据，但尚未证明AD方法在不同机器人控制策略和任务类型之间的可迁移性。利用时间序列数据（例如力/扭矩信号）可以直接捕获机器人与环境的交互，这对于操作和在线故障检测至关重要。它们的广泛可用性、高采样率和低维度特性使得高时间分辨率和高效处理成为可能。由于机器人任务可能具有广泛的信号特性和要求，因此需要一种能够以相同方式应用于广泛任务的AD方法，理想情况下应具有良好的数据效率。我们研究了三种工业任务，每种任务都存在多种异常。建立了机器人布线、拧螺丝和打磨的测试场景，并收集了多模态时间序列数据。比较了几种基于自编码器的方法，并评估了它们在不同任务和控制方法（扩散策略控制、位置控制和阻抗控制）之间的泛化能力。这使我们能够验证AD在涉及更严格公差以及机器人及其环境变化的复杂任务中的集成。此外，我们评估了数据效率、检测延迟以及支持鲁棒检测的任务特性。结果表明，在布线和拧螺丝任务中的故障（例如零件不正确或未对准）实现了超过0.96的可靠检测AUROC。在抛光任务中，只有严重故障能够被可靠检测，而更细微的故障仍未被检测到。
AI.summary: 本文解决了机器人操作中通用故障监测的异常检测（AD）方法缺乏跨任务和跨控制策略可迁移性的问题。研究利用力/扭矩等时间序列数据，比较了基于自编码器的AD方法在机器人布线、拧螺丝和打磨三种工业任务中的泛化能力，涵盖了扩散策略、位置和阻抗控制等多种控制方法。结果显示，该方法在布线和拧螺丝任务中对故障的检测可靠性高（AUROC > 0.96），成功验证了AD在复杂任务中的集成性，但指出其在打磨任务中对细微故障的检测仍存在不足。
AI.keywords: 异常检测, 机器人操作, 时间序列数据, 自编码器, 故障监测
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于明确研究了异常检测（AD）方法在不同机器人任务类型（装配、拧螺丝、操作）和不同控制策略（扩散策略、位置、阻抗）之间的可迁移性和通用性。通过利用易于获取的力/扭矩时间序列数据，该研究旨在提供一种数据高效且通用的在线故障监测方案。然而，结果显示性能并非在所有任务中都一致（打磨任务中的细微故障难以检测），这突出了设计通用AD模型时，任务特性对信号特征和检测鲁棒性的重要影响，为未来研究指明了方向。

title: Sample-Efficient Differentially Private Fine-Tuning via Gradient Matrix Denoising
comments: Added additional experiments for 1. including generative tasks and auto-regressive llms, 2. showing the delay in differentially private optimization, and 3. explaining the choice of kappa. Added better explanation for theoretical benefits of norm correction and the need for threshold
summary: We address the challenge of sample efficiency in differentially private fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs) using DP-SGD. While DP-SGD provides strong privacy guarantees, the added noise significantly increases the entropy of gradient matrices, disrupting their low-rank structure and slowing optimization. We propose a post-processing algorithm that leverages random matrix theory to denoise gradients, restore low-rank structure, and improve alignment with the original signal. Applied to DP-SGD fine-tuning of RoBERTa on GLUE tasks, our method improves sample efficiency compared to state-of-the-art approaches, substantially reducing training time when optimal performance is not required. This work demonstrates that matrix recovery techniques can enhance the utility of private language model training without compromising privacy guarantees.
comment: Added additional experiments for 1. including generative tasks and auto-regressive llms, 2. showing the delay in differentially private optimization, and 3. explaining the choice of kappa. Added better explanation for theoretical benefits of norm correction and the need for threshold

AI.title_translation: 通过梯度矩阵去噪实现样本高效的差分隐私微调
AI.tldr: 针对使用DP-SGD对大型语言模型进行差分隐私微调时的样本效率低下问题，本文提出了一种基于随机矩阵理论的后处理算法来对梯度进行去噪，恢复其低秩结构，从而提高了样本效率，并在不影响隐私保证的前提下显著减少了训练时间。
AI.motivation: 解决使用DP-SGD对大型语言模型（LLMs）进行差分隐私微调时样本效率低下的挑战。DP-SGD引入的噪声显著增加了梯度矩阵的熵，破坏了其低秩结构并减慢了优化过程。
AI.method: 提出了一种后处理算法，该算法利用随机矩阵理论对梯度进行去噪，恢复梯度矩阵的低秩结构，并改善其与原始信号的对齐。
AI.result: 在RoBERTa模型上应用于GLUE任务的DP-SGD微调时，该方法与现有最先进的方法相比，提高了样本效率，并在不需要最佳性能时显著减少了训练时间。
AI.conclusion: 矩阵恢复技术可以增强私有语言模型训练的实用性，而不会损害隐私保证。
AI.translation: 我们解决了使用差分隐私随机梯度下降（DP-SGD）对大型语言模型（LLMs）进行差分隐私微调时样本效率低下的挑战。虽然DP-SGD提供了强大的隐私保证，但所增加的噪声显著增加了梯度矩阵的熵，破坏了它们的低秩结构并减慢了优化。我们提出了一种后处理算法，该算法利用随机矩阵理论对梯度进行去噪，恢复低秩结构，并改善与原始信号的对齐。将该方法应用于RoBERTa在GLUE任务上的DP-SGD微调时，与现有最先进的方法相比，我们的方法提高了样本效率，并在不需要最佳性能时显著减少了训练时间。这项工作表明，矩阵恢复技术可以在不损害隐私保证的情况下提高私有语言模型训练的实用性。
AI.summary: 本文关注DP-SGD微调大型语言模型时的样本效率问题。DP-SGD引入的噪声会破坏梯度矩阵的低秩结构。为解决此问题，作者提出了一种利用随机矩阵理论的梯度去噪后处理算法，旨在恢复低秩结构并增强信号对齐。实验结果表明，该方法在RoBERTa的GLUE任务微调中提高了样本效率，并在保证隐私的前提下显著缩短了训练时间，证明了矩阵恢复技术在增强私有模型实用性方面的有效性。
AI.keywords: 差分隐私微调, 样本效率, 梯度去噪, 随机矩阵理论, DP-SGD
AI.comments: 这项工作的创新点在于将随机矩阵理论（Random Matrix Theory, RMT）和矩阵恢复技术应用于差分隐私训练中的梯度去噪。传统的DP-SGD通过添加高斯噪声牺牲了模型性能和训练效率，而本文的方法通过后处理恢复了梯度固有的低秩结构，这对于大型模型的高效优化至关重要。其重要性在于提供了一种在保持严格隐私保证的同时，显著提高DP-SGD样本效率和实用性的新途径，尤其适用于需要快速迭代或资源受限的场景。

title: Parallel Test-Time Scaling for Latent Reasoning Models
summary: Parallel test-time scaling (TTS) is a pivotal approach for enhancing large language models (LLMs), typically by sampling multiple token-based chains-of-thought in parallel and aggregating outcomes through voting or search. Recent advances in latent reasoning, where intermediate reasoning unfolds in continuous vector spaces, offer a more efficient alternative to explicit Chain-of-Thought, yet whether such latent models can similarly benefit from parallel TTS remains open, mainly due to the absence of sampling mechanisms in continuous space, and the lack of probabilistic signals for advanced trajectory aggregation. This work enables parallel TTS for latent reasoning models by addressing the above issues. For sampling, we introduce two uncertainty-inspired stochastic strategies: Monte Carlo Dropout and Additive Gaussian Noise. For aggregation, we design a Latent Reward Model (LatentRM) trained with step-wise contrastive objective to score and guide latent reasoning. Extensive experiments and visualization analyses show that both sampling strategies scale effectively with compute and exhibit distinct exploration dynamics, while LatentRM enables effective trajectory selection. Together, our explorations open a new direction for scalable inference in continuous spaces. Code and checkpoints released at https://github.com/ModalityDance/LatentTTS

AI.title_translation: 潜在推理模型的并行测试时缩放
AI.tldr: 本文为潜在推理模型引入了并行测试时缩放（TTS）。通过使用蒙特卡洛丢弃和高斯噪声实现连续空间采样，并设计了一个潜在奖励模型（LatentRM）进行轨迹聚合，实验证明该方法有效且可扩展，为连续空间推理开辟了新方向。
AI.motivation: 传统的并行测试时缩放（TTS）依赖于基于token的思维链采样和聚合。虽然潜在推理模型提供了更高效的替代方案，但由于缺乏连续空间采样机制和高级轨迹聚合所需的概率信号，TTS尚未能应用于这些模型。本文旨在解决这些问题。
AI.method: 针对连续空间采样，提出了两种受不确定性启发的随机策略：蒙特卡洛丢弃（Monte Carlo Dropout）和附加高斯噪声（Additive Gaussian Noise）。针对聚合问题，设计了一个潜在奖励模型（LatentRM），该模型通过逐步对比目标进行训练，用于对潜在推理过程进行评分和指导。
AI.result: 实验和可视化分析表明，两种采样策略都能有效地随计算资源扩展，并展现出不同的探索动态；同时，LatentRM能够实现有效的轨迹选择。
AI.conclusion: 我们的探索为连续空间中的可扩展推理开辟了一个新方向。
AI.translation: 并行测试时缩放（TTS）是增强大型语言模型（LLMs）的关键方法，通常通过并行采样多个基于token的思维链（Chains-of-Thought）并通过投票或搜索聚合结果。最近在潜在推理方面取得的进展，其中中间推理在连续向量空间中展开，提供了一种比显式思维链更高效的替代方案。然而，此类潜在模型是否也能受益于并行TTS仍然是一个悬而未决的问题，这主要是因为连续空间中缺乏采样机制，以及缺乏用于高级轨迹聚合的概率信号。本工作通过解决上述问题，使并行TTS能够应用于潜在推理模型。对于采样，我们引入了两种受不确定性启发的随机策略：蒙特卡洛丢弃（Monte Carlo Dropout）和附加高斯噪声（Additive Gaussian Noise）。对于聚合，我们设计了一个潜在奖励模型（LatentRM），该模型通过逐步对比目标进行训练，用于对潜在推理进行评分和指导。广泛的实验和可视化分析表明，两种采样策略都能有效地随计算资源扩展，并展现出不同的探索动态，同时LatentRM能够实现有效的轨迹选择。总而言之，我们的探索为连续空间中的可扩展推理开辟了一个新方向。
AI.summary: 并行测试时缩放（TTS）是增强大型语言模型（LLMs）的关键技术。本文解决了将TTS应用于高效的潜在推理模型中的挑战，这些模型在连续向量空间中展开推理。针对连续空间中缺乏采样机制和聚合信号的问题，作者引入了两种不确定性启发式随机采样策略（蒙特卡洛丢弃和附加高斯噪声），并设计了一个通过逐步对比目标训练的潜在奖励模型（LatentRM）来进行轨迹评分和聚合。实验证明，所提出的采样策略具有良好的可扩展性，且LatentRM能够实现有效的轨迹选择，从而为连续空间中的可扩展推理提供了新的途径。
AI.keywords: 潜在推理模型, 并行测试时缩放, 连续空间采样, 潜在奖励模型, 蒙特卡洛丢弃
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于成功地将并行测试时缩放（TTS）这一原本针对离散token（如思维链 CoT）的技术，推广应用到了连续的潜在推理空间。这种迁移解决了一个关键的技术难题：如何在连续空间中生成多样化的推理轨迹并进行有效的评估和聚合。LatentRM的设计，特别是其基于逐步对比目标的训练，是实现有效轨迹选择的核心，这对于提高潜在推理模型的鲁棒性和性能具有重要意义。它为未来在连续表示上进行更高效、更具可扩展性的推理提供了基础。

title: The Price of Thought: A Multilingual Analysis of Reasoning, Performance, and Cost of Negotiation in Large Language Models
summary: Negotiation is a fundamental challenge for AI agents, as it requires an ability to reason strategically, model opponents, and balance cooperation with competition. We present the first comprehensive study that systematically evaluates how explicit reasoning training affects the negotiation abilities of both commercial and open-weight large language models, comparing these models to their vanilla counterparts across three languages. Using a self-play setup across three diverse dialogue games, we analyse trade-offs between performance and cost, the language consistency of reasoning processes, and the nature of strategic adaptation exhibited by models. Our findings show that enabling reasoning -- that is, scaling test time compute -- significantly improves negotiation outcomes by enhancing collaboration and helping models overcome task complexities, but comes at a substantial computational cost: reasoning improves GPT-5's performance by 31.4 % while increasing its cost by nearly 400 %. Most critically, we uncover a significant multilingual reasoning distinction: open-weight models consistently switch to English for their internal reasoning steps, even when negotiating in German or Italian (and thus possibly impacting potential explainability gains through the disclosure of reasoning traces), while a leading commercial model maintains language consistency between reasoning and final output.

AI.title_translation: 思维的代价：大型语言模型中推理、性能和谈判成本的多语言分析
AI.tldr: 给LLM增加推理能力（“思考”）能显著提高谈判性能，但计算成本极高（GPT-5成本增加400%）。此外，开源LLM在非英语谈判中倾向于用英语进行内部推理，存在多语言推理不一致问题。
AI.motivation: 谈判对于AI智能体是一个基础挑战，本研究旨在系统评估显式推理训练如何影响商业和开源大型语言模型的谈判能力，并在三种语言中进行比较。
AI.method: 使用自我对弈设置（self-play setup）在三种不同的对话博弈中进行。系统地评估了显式推理训练的影响，并将商业和开源模型与其原始版本进行对比。分析维度包括性能与成本的权衡、推理过程的语言一致性以及战略适应性。
AI.result: 启用推理（即增加测试时计算量）显著提高了谈判结果，增强了协作并克服了任务复杂性，但计算成本高昂。例如，GPT-5的性能提高了31.4%，但成本增加了近400%。开源模型在内部推理步骤中始终切换到英语（即使在德语或意大利语谈判中），而领先的商业模型保持了推理和最终输出的语言一致性。
AI.conclusion: 提高推理能力能显著改善LLM的谈判性能，但代价是计算成本大幅增加。此外，开源模型在多语言推理中存在语言切换现象，可能影响通过公开推理痕迹实现的可解释性收益。
AI.translation: 谈判是AI智能体面临的一个基本挑战，因为它需要智能体具备战略推理、对手建模以及平衡合作与竞争的能力。我们提出了首个综合研究，系统地评估了显式推理训练如何影响商业和开源大型语言模型的谈判能力，并将其与它们在三种语言中的原始版本进行了比较。我们使用在三种不同对话博弈中的自我对弈设置，分析了性能和成本之间的权衡、推理过程的语言一致性以及模型表现出的战略适应性。我们的研究结果表明，启用推理——即增加测试时的计算量——通过增强协作和帮助模型克服任务复杂性，显著改善了谈判结果，但这带来了巨大的计算成本：推理将GPT-5的性能提高了31.4%，而其成本增加了近400%。最关键的是，我们发现了一个显著的多语言推理区别：开源模型始终切换到英语进行内部推理步骤，即使在使用德语或意大利语进行谈判时（因此可能影响通过披露推理痕迹获得的潜在可解释性收益），而一个领先的商业模型则在推理和最终输出之间保持了语言一致性。
AI.summary: 本文是首个系统评估显式推理训练对商业和开源大型语言模型谈判能力影响的综合研究。研究使用自我对弈设置和三种对话博弈，分析了性能、成本和多语言一致性的权衡。结果显示，启用推理显著提高了谈判结果（通过增强协作），但带来了巨大的计算成本（如GPT-5成本增加400%）。更关键的是，开源模型在德语或意大利语谈判中，其内部推理步骤会一致切换到英语，而领先的商业模型则保持了语言一致性。
AI.keywords: 谈判, 推理, 大型语言模型, 多语言分析, 计算成本
AI.comments: 本研究的创新之处在于首次系统地量化了在大型语言模型谈判任务中，推理能力带来的性能提升与计算成本之间的权衡（如GPT-5的成本增加了400%以换取31.4%的性能提升）。这一发现对于实际部署和资源优化具有重要的指导意义。此外，研究揭示了开源模型在多语言环境中进行内部推理时，会普遍切换到英语，这不仅暴露了这些模型在非英语推理方面的局限性，也对利用推理痕迹提高非英语任务可解释性的努力提出了挑战。

title: Identifying Video Game Debugging Bottlenecks: An Industry Perspective
comments: 8 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables, gas 2026 conference submission
summary: Conventional debugging techniques used in traditional software are similarly used when debugging video games. However, the reality of video games require its own set of unique debugging techniques such as On-Screen Console, Debug Draws, Debug Camera, Cheats and In-Game Menus, and Data Scrubbing. In this article, we provide insights from a video game studio on how 20 seasoned industry game developers debug during the production of a game. Our experiments rely on the recordings of debugging sessions for the most critical bugs categorized as Crashes, Object Behaviors, and Object Persistence. In this paper, we focus on identifying the debugging activities that bottleneck bug resolution. We also identify the debugging tools used to perform debugging techniques. Lastly, we present how different disciplines collaborate during debugging and how technical roles are at the core of debugging. Our thematic analysis has identified game developers spend 36.6\% of their time inspecting game artifacts and 35.1\% of their time reproducing the bug locally.
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables, gas 2026 conference submission

AI.title_translation: 识别电子游戏调试瓶颈：一个行业视角
AI.tldr: 研究调查了20位资深游戏开发者，发现他们的大部分调试时间（约70%）花费在检查游戏工件和本地重现错误上，这表明这些是主要的调试瓶颈。文章还确定了独特的调试工具和跨学科协作模式。
AI.motivation: 识别和分析电子游戏调试中的瓶颈活动和独特工具，以改进调试效率。游戏调试与传统软件调试有差异，需要独特的技巧（如On-Screen Console、Debug Draws等）。
AI.method: 收集并记录来自一家视频游戏工作室的20位资深开发者在处理关键错误（崩溃、对象行为、对象持久性）时的调试会话数据。使用主题分析法识别瓶颈活动和所使用的工具。
AI.result: 游戏开发者将36.6%的时间用于检查游戏工件（artifacts），35.1%的时间用于在本地重现错误，表明这些是解决错误的瓶颈活动。研究还确定了用于执行调试技术的工具，并阐述了不同学科在调试中的协作模式。
AI.translation: 传统软件中使用的常规调试技术也用于电子游戏调试。然而，电子游戏的实际情况需要一套独特的调试技术，例如屏幕控制台（On-Screen Console）、调试绘图（Debug Draws）、调试镜头（Debug Camera）、作弊码（Cheats）和游戏内菜单（In-Game Menus），以及数据清洗（Data Scrubbing）。在本文中，我们提供了一家视频游戏工作室的见解，介绍了20位经验丰富的行业游戏开发者在游戏制作过程中如何进行调试。我们的实验依赖于针对最关键错误（归类为崩溃、对象行为和对象持久性）的调试会话记录。本文重点在于识别阻碍错误解决的调试活动瓶颈。我们还确定了用于执行调试技术的工具。最后，我们介绍了不同学科在调试期间如何协作，以及技术角色如何成为调试的核心。我们的主题分析发现，游戏开发者将36.6%的时间用于检查游戏工件，35.1%的时间用于在本地重现错误。
AI.summary: 本文从行业角度分析了电子游戏调试中的瓶颈。通过记录20位资深开发者的调试会话并进行主题分析，研究发现游戏开发者的大部分时间被用于检查游戏工件和本地重现错误。文章还识别了游戏特有的调试技巧及其相关工具，并探讨了不同学科在调试过程中的协作模式，强调了技术角色在其中的核心地位。
AI.keywords: 电子游戏调试, 调试瓶颈, 行业视角, 主题分析, 游戏工件
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于提供了对视频游戏调试实践的定量行业洞察，填补了现有研究的空白。它强调了游戏开发与传统软件开发的区别，并具体指出了时间消耗最大的瓶颈（检查游戏工件和本地重现错误）。这对于游戏工作室优化工作流程和开发更高效的调试工具具有重要意义。局限性可能在于样本量和数据来源可能仅限于一家工作室。

title: ADVICE: Answer-Dependent Verbalized Confidence Estimation
summary: Recent progress in large language models (LLMs) has enabled them to communicate their confidence in natural language, improving transparency and reliability. However, this expressiveness is often accompanied by systematic overconfidence, whose underlying causes remain poorly understood. In this work, we analyze the dynamics of verbalized confidence estimation and identify answer-independence -- the failure to condition confidence on the model's own answer -- as a primary driver of this behavior. To address this, we introduce ADVICE (Answer-Dependent Verbalized Confidence Estimation), a fine-tuning framework that promotes answer-grounded confidence estimation. Extensive experiments show that ADVICE substantially improves confidence calibration, while exhibiting strong generalization to unseen settings without degrading task performance. We further demonstrate that these gains stem from enhanced answer dependence, shedding light on the origins of overconfidence and enabling trustworthy confidence verbalization.

AI.title_translation: ADVICE：依赖答案的口头化置信度估计
AI.tldr: 针对大型语言模型（LLMs）系统性过度自信的问题，本文提出ADVICE（依赖答案的口头化置信度估计）微调框架。ADVICE通过强制置信度估计依赖于模型自身的答案，显著改善了置信度校准，同时保持了任务性能和泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）能够以自然语言表达其置信度，但这通常伴随着系统性的过度自信，其根本原因尚不清楚。本文旨在解决这一问题，并分析过度自信的驱动因素。
AI.method: 分析了口头化置信度估计的动态，并将“答案独立性”（即置信度未能基于模型自身的答案进行调整）确定为过度自信的主要驱动因素。为解决此问题，提出了ADVICE（依赖答案的口头化置信度估计）微调框架，该框架旨在促进以答案为基础的置信度估计。
AI.result: ADVICE显著改善了置信度校准，同时对未见过的设置表现出强大的泛化能力，且没有降低任务性能。
AI.conclusion: ADVICE的改进源于增强了答案依赖性，这揭示了过度自信的根源，并实现了值得信赖的置信度口头化。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）的最新进展使其能够用自然语言传达其置信度，从而提高了透明度和可靠性。然而，这种表达能力通常伴随着系统性的过度自信，其潜在原因仍知之甚少。在这项工作中，我们分析了口头化置信度估计的动态，并将答案独立性——即未能根据模型自身的答案来调整置信度——确定为这种行为的主要驱动因素。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了ADVICE（依赖答案的口头化置信度估计），这是一个促进以答案为基础的置信度估计的微调框架。大量的实验表明，ADVICE显著改善了置信度校准，同时对未见过的设置表现出强大的泛化能力，且没有降低任务性能。我们进一步证明，这些改进源于增强的答案依赖性，这揭示了过度自信的起源，并实现了值得信赖的置信度口头化。
AI.summary: 本文旨在解决大型语言模型（LLMs）普遍存在的系统性过度自信问题。通过分析口头化置信度估计，研究发现过度自信主要由“答案独立性”（即置信度未依赖于模型自身答案）驱动。为解决此问题，作者提出了ADVICE（依赖答案的口头化置信度估计）微调框架，该框架通过促进答案依赖性来校准置信度。实验证明ADVICE能大幅提升置信度校准，保持任务性能，并展现出强大的泛化能力。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 置信度估计, 过度自信, 校准, ADVICE
AI.comments: 本研究创新性地将LLM过度自信的系统性问题归因于模型输出的“答案独立性”，即置信度估计与实际答案脱钩。提出的ADVICE微调框架是一个直接且实用的解决方案，通过强制答案依赖性来校准口头化置信度，显著提高了模型的可信赖性（trustworthiness）。其重要性在于，它不仅提供了一个解决过度自信的技术方法，还深入解释了这一现象的潜在机制，对于未来构建更可靠、更透明的LLM至关重要。

title: KOTOX: A Korean Toxic Dataset for Deobfuscation and Detoxification
summary: Online communication increasingly amplifies toxic language, and recent research actively explores methods for detecting and rewriting such content. Existing studies primarily focus on non-obfuscated text, which limits robustness in the situation where users intentionally disguise toxic expressions. In particular, Korean allows toxic expressions to be easily disguised through its agglutinative characteristic. However, obfuscation in Korean remains largely unexplored, which motivates us to introduce a KOTOX: Korean toxic dataset for deobfuscation and detoxification. We categorize Korean obfuscation patterns into linguistically grounded classes and define transformation rules derived from real-world examples. Using these rules, we provide paired neutral and toxic sentences alongside their obfuscated counterparts. Models trained on our dataset better handle obfuscated text without sacrificing performance on non-obfuscated text. This is the first dataset that simultaneously supports deobfuscation and detoxification for the Korean language. We expect it to facilitate better understanding and mitigation of obfuscated toxic content in LLM for Korean. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/leeyejin1231/KOTOX.

AI.title_translation: KOTOX：一个用于去混淆和解毒的韩语有毒数据集
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了KOTOX，一个韩语有毒数据集，用于处理被故意伪装的有毒表达。该数据集对韩语的混淆模式进行了分类，并提供了相应的规则和配对句子，以帮助模型更好地理解和处理被混淆的有毒内容，同时不牺牲对非混淆文本的性能。这是首个同时支持韩语去混淆和解毒的数据集。
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要集中在非混淆文本，在用户故意伪装有毒表达的情况下鲁棒性有限。特别是，韩语的黏着性特征使其容易伪装有毒表达，但这一领域的研究尚不充分。
AI.method: 对韩语的混淆模式进行分类，定义了基于真实世界示例的转换规则。利用这些规则，提供了成对的中性、有毒句子及其被混淆的版本。
AI.result: 在KOTOX数据集上训练的模型能够更好地处理被混淆的文本，同时不牺牲对非混淆文本的性能。
AI.conclusion: KOTOX是首个同时支持韩语去混淆和解毒的数据集，有望促进对大型语言模型中韩语被混淆的有毒内容的更好理解和缓解。
AI.translation: 在线交流日益加剧有毒语言的传播，近期研究积极探索检测和改写此类内容的方法。现有研究主要关注非混淆文本，这在用户故意伪装有毒表达的情况下限制了鲁棒性。特别是，韩语的黏着性特征使其能够轻松伪装有毒表达。然而，韩语中的混淆现象仍未得到充分探索，这促使我们引入KOTOX：一个用于去混淆和解毒的韩语有毒数据集。我们将韩语的混淆模式归类为基于语言学的类别，并定义了源自真实世界示例的转换规则。利用这些规则，我们提供了成对的中性句子和有毒句子，以及它们的混淆版本。在本数据集上训练的模型能够更好地处理混淆文本，而不会牺牲对非混淆文本的性能。这是首个同时支持韩语去混淆和解毒的数据集。我们期望它能促进对大型语言模型中韩语混淆有毒内容的更好理解和缓解。我们的代码和数据可在https://github.com/leeyejin1231/KOTOX 获取。
AI.summary: 本研究介绍了KOTOX，一个专门为韩语设计的有毒文本数据集，旨在解决在线交流中有毒语言的混淆问题。该数据集通过对韩语的混淆模式进行分类并制定相应的转换规则，提供了成对的有毒和中性句子及其混淆版本。实验表明，使用KOTOX训练的模型在处理混淆文本方面表现更优，同时保持了对非混淆文本的性能。该数据集是首个同时支持韩语去混淆和解毒的资源，有望推动对大型语言模型中韩语混淆有毒内容的理解和治理。
AI.keywords: 韩语有毒数据集, 去混淆, 解毒, 语言混淆, 在线沟通
AI.comments: 该研究解决了韩语有毒语言混淆这一重要且被忽视的问题，通过构建KOTOX数据集，为相关研究提供了宝贵的资源。数据集的构建方法具有语言学基础，并且考虑了真实世界的应用场景。然而，该研究的局限性可能在于混淆模式的覆盖范围和模型的泛化能力，未来可以进一步探索更广泛的混淆策略和更复杂的模型。

title: ContractEval: A Benchmark for Evaluating Contract-Satisfying Assertions in Code Generation
summary: Current code generation benchmarks measure functional correctness on well-formed inputs, as test cases are curated to satisfy input preconditions. This leaves a gap: generated programs may appear correct but fail to satisfy contracts -- assertion-level validity constraints for rejecting ill-formed inputs. We introduce ContractEval, a benchmark for evaluating contract-satisfying assertions in code generation, i.e., whether code rejects contract-violating inputs by triggering intended assertions. Built on HumanEval+ and MBPP+, ContractEval augments each task with contract-violation tests derived from reference assertions. We synthesize these via a neuro-symbolic pipeline: an LLM converts assertion clauses into constraints, and an SMT solver enumerates satisfiable violation combinations to generate inputs that violate selected clauses while satisfying the rest. Across five code LLMs, standard prompting yields 0% contract satisfaction, while adding a few contract-violation examples boosts contract satisfaction to 49--53% while maintaining pass@1 by 92% of the original. Our code is available at https://github.com/suhanmen/ContractEval.

AI.title_translation: ContractEval：一个用于评估代码生成中满足契约断言的基准。
AI.tldr: 我们推出了ContractEval基准，用于测试AI生成的代码是否能在输入违反契约时正确触发断言。标准提示下，模型契约满意度为0%，但提供少量契约违反示例后，满意度可提升至49%—53%，且不影响功能正确性。
AI.motivation: 当前的代码生成基准仅衡量代码在满足输入前置条件的良好输入上的功能正确性，忽略了生成的程序是否能通过触发预期的断言来拒绝违反契约的畸形输入。
AI.method: 引入了ContractEval基准，它基于HumanEval+和MBPP+构建，并通过参考断言导出的契约违反测试来增强每个任务。测试的生成采用神经符号管道：大型语言模型（LLM）将断言子句转换为约束，然后SMT求解器枚举可满足的违反组合以生成输入。
AI.result: 在五种代码LLM上测试发现，标准提示的契约满意度为0%。添加少量契约违反示例后，契约满意度提高到49%至53%，同时保持了原始pass@1得分的92%。
AI.conclusion: ContractEval揭示了当前代码LLM在契约满足方面的严重缺陷。通过少量的示例提示，可以显著提高模型的契约满足能力，同时保持功能正确性。
AI.translation: 当前的代码生成基准通过精心策划满足输入前置条件的测试用例，来衡量在良好输入上的功能正确性。这留下了一个空白：生成的程序可能看起来正确，但未能满足契约——即用于拒绝畸形输入的断言级有效性约束。我们引入了ContractEval，这是一个用于评估代码生成中满足契约断言的基准，即代码是否通过触发预期的断言来拒绝违反契约的输入。ContractEval建立在HumanEval+和MBPP+之上，通过从参考断言中导出的契约违反测试来增强每个任务。我们通过神经符号管道合成这些测试：一个大型语言模型（LLM）将断言子句转换为约束，然后一个SMT求解器枚举可满足的违反组合，以生成违反选定子句但满足其余子句的输入。在五种代码LLM上测试发现，标准提示的契约满意度为0%，而添加少量契约违反示例后，契约满意度提高到49%至53%，同时保持了原始pass@1得分的92%。我们的代码可在https://github.com/suhanmen/ContractEval获取。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了ContractEval，这是一个用于评估代码生成模型是否能通过触发预期断言来拒绝违反契约输入的基准。现有的基准测试通常忽略了这一断言级别的有效性约束。ContractEval基于HumanEval+和MBPP+构建，并使用神经符号管道（LLM和SMT求解器）生成契约违反测试。实验结果表明，标准提示下模型的契约满意度为0%，而通过少量契约违反示例的提示，满意度可提高至49%至53%，同时功能正确性保持良好。
AI.keywords: ContractEval, 代码生成, 断言, 基准测试, 神经符号
AI.comments: 这项工作的创新之处在于解决了功能正确性与契约满意度之间的关键差距，这对于构建健壮的软件至关重要。用于生成目标性违反测试的神经符号管道是一种新颖且有效的方法。结果有力地证明了LLM默认情况下优先考虑功能输出，而非防御性编程（契约执行），突显了未来模型改进的一个关键领域。

title: Topological Signatures of ReLU Neural Network Activation Patterns
summary: This paper explores the topological signatures of ReLU neural network activation patterns. We consider feedforward neural networks with ReLU activation functions and analyze the polytope decomposition of the feature space induced by the network. Mainly, we investigate how the Fiedler partition of the dual graph and show that it appears to correlate with the decision boundary -- in the case of binary classification. Additionally, we compute the homology of the cellular decomposition -- in a regression task -- to draw similar patterns in behavior between the training loss and polyhedral cell-count, as the model is trained.

AI.title_translation: ReLU神经网络激活模式的拓扑特征
AI.tldr: 该论文研究了ReLU神经网络激活模式的拓扑特征，特别是多面体分解、对偶图的Fiedler划分以及与决策边界和训练损失的关系。
AI.motivation: 探索ReLU神经网络激活模式的拓扑特征，并研究其与网络行为（如决策边界和训练损失）的关系。
AI.method: 分析了ReLU神经网络诱导的特征空间的多面体分解，研究了对偶图的Fiedler划分，并计算了胞腔分解的同调性。
AI.result: Fiedler划分似乎与二元分类的决策边界相关；在回归任务中，训练损失与多面体单元数量之间存在相似的行为模式。
AI.conclusion: ReLU神经网络的激活模式具有可识别的拓扑特征，这些特征与网络的分类和回归性能相关，为理解神经网络行为提供了一种新的视角。
AI.translation: 本文探讨了ReLU神经网络激活模式的拓扑特征。我们考虑具有ReLU激活函数的前馈神经网络，并分析网络诱导的特征空间的多面体分解。主要地，我们研究了对偶图的Fiedler划分，并表明它似乎与二元分类的决策边界相关。此外，我们计算了回归任务中胞腔分解的同调性，以在训练模型时绘制训练损失和多面体单元计数之间的相似行为模式。
AI.summary: 本研究调查了ReLU神经网络激活模式的拓扑特征，通过分析特征空间的多面体分解。研究发现，对偶图的Fiedler划分与二元分类的决策边界相关，并且在回归任务中，训练损失与多面体单元的数量之间存在相似的行为模式。
AI.keywords: ReLU神经网络, 拓扑特征, 多面体分解, Fiedler划分, 决策边界
AI.comments: 这项工作将拓扑学方法应用于理解神经网络，特别是ReLU网络。研究结果表明，拓扑特征（如Fiedler划分和同调性）可以揭示与网络性能相关的结构。该研究的局限性在于其主要关注理论分析，并且对于更复杂的网络架构和任务的普适性需要进一步验证。

title: Scaling Beyond Context: A Survey of Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Document Understanding
summary: Document understanding is critical for applications from financial analysis to scientific discovery. Current approaches, whether OCR-based pipelines feeding Large Language Models (LLMs) or native Multimodal LLMs (MLLMs), face key limitations: the former loses structural detail, while the latter struggles with context modeling. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) helps ground models in external data, but documents' multimodal nature, i.e., combining text, tables, charts, and layout, demands a more advanced paradigm: Multimodal RAG. This approach enables holistic retrieval and reasoning across all modalities, unlocking comprehensive document intelligence. Recognizing its importance, this paper presents a systematic survey of Multimodal RAG for document understanding. We propose a taxonomy based on domain, retrieval modality, and granularity, and review advances involving graph structures and agentic frameworks. We also summarize key datasets, benchmarks, applications and industry deployment, and highlight open challenges in efficiency, fine-grained representation, and robustness, providing a roadmap for future progress in document AI.

AI.title_translation: 超越上下文的扩展：文档理解的多模态检索增强生成调查
AI.tldr: 文档理解需要更先进的多模态RAG来克服现有LLM和MLLM的局限性。本文系统性地综述了Multimodal RAG，提出了一个分类法，并讨论了数据集、应用和未来的主要挑战，旨在推动文档AI的发展。
AI.motivation: 现有的文档理解方法（如基于OCR的管道或原生的多模态LLMs）存在局限性：前者丢失结构细节，后者在上下文建模方面存在困难。文档的多模态特性（文本、表格、图表和布局的结合）要求更先进的多模态RAG范式来解决这些问题。
AI.method: 通过系统性地调查和回顾多模态RAG在文档理解中的进展，提出了一个基于领域、检索模态和粒度的分类法，并审查了涉及图结构和主体框架的最新进展。
AI.result: 提出了一个基于领域、检索模态和粒度的多模态RAG分类法，并回顾了利用图结构和主体框架的最新进展，同时总结了关键数据集、基准测试、应用和行业部署。
AI.conclusion: 本文总结了多模态RAG在文档理解中的关键数据集、基准测试、应用和行业部署，并重点指出了效率、细粒度表示和鲁棒性方面的开放性挑战，为文档人工智能的未来发展提供了路线图。
AI.translation: 文档理解对于从金融分析到科学发现等应用至关重要。当前的方法，无论是为大型语言模型（LLMs）提供输入的基于OCR的管道，还是原生的多模态LLMs（MLLMs），都面临关键限制：前者会丢失结构细节，而后者在上下文建模方面存在困难。检索增强生成（RAG）有助于模型以外部数据为基础，但文档的多模态性质，即文本、表格、图表和布局的结合，需要一个更先进的范式：多模态RAG。这种方法可以实现跨所有模态的整体检索和推理，从而解锁全面的文档智能。认识到其重要性，本文对用于文档理解的多模态RAG进行了系统的综述。我们提出了一个基于领域、检索模态和粒度的分类法，并回顾了涉及图结构和主体框架的进展。我们还总结了关键数据集、基准测试、应用和行业部署，并重点介绍了效率、细粒度表示和鲁棒性方面的开放性挑战，为文档AI的未来进步提供了路线图。
AI.summary: 本文对用于文档理解的多模态检索增强生成（Multimodal RAG）进行了系统性综述。它指出了传统方法在处理文档多模态信息时的不足，并强调了Multimodal RAG在实现跨模态的整体检索和推理方面的潜力。作者提出了一个基于领域、模态和粒度的分类法，并概述了相关数据集、挑战和未来研究方向。
AI.keywords: 多模态RAG, 文档理解, 检索增强生成, 大语言模型, 模态融合
AI.comments: 这项工作的重要性在于它系统地梳理了多模态检索增强生成（Multimodal RAG）在文档理解这一关键领域的前沿进展，并提出了一个清晰的分类法，为未来的研究指明了方向。其创新点在于强调了超越传统上下文限制，通过整合文本、表格、图表和布局等多种模态进行全面检索和推理。

title: Typing Strictness (Extended Version)
comments: 30 pages, 22 figures, extended version of a paper at POPL 2026
summary: Strictness analysis is critical to efficient implementation of languages with non-strict evaluation, mitigating much of the performance overhead of laziness. However, reasoning about strictness at the source level can be challenging and unintuitive. We propose a new definition of strictness that refines the traditional one by describing variable usage more precisely. We lay type-theoretic foundations for this definition in both call-by-name and call-by-push-value settings, drawing inspiration from the literature on type systems tracking effects and coeffects. We prove via a logical relation that the strictness attributes computed by our type systems accurately describe the use of variables at runtime, and we offer a strictness-annotation-preserving translation from the call-by-name system to the call-by-push-value one. All our results are mechanized in Rocq.

AI.title_translation: 类型化严格性（扩展版本）
AI.tldr: 提出了一种更精确的严格性新定义，并为其在传名调用（CBN）和传值传名（CBPV）设置中建立了类型理论基础，通过逻辑关系证明了其准确性，所有结果均已在Rocq中机械化。
AI.motivation: 严格性分析对于高效实现非严格求值语言至关重要，但从源代码层面推理严格性具有挑战性且不直观。
AI.method: 提出了一种通过更精确描述变量使用来改进传统严格性的新定义。借鉴跟踪效应和共效应的类型系统，在传名调用（CBN）和传值传名（CBPV）设置中奠定了类型理论基础。通过逻辑关系证明类型系统计算出的严格性属性的准确性。
AI.result: 通过逻辑关系证明了类型系统计算的严格性属性准确描述了变量在运行时的使用。提供了一个从传名调用系统到传值传名系统的保持严格性标注的翻译。所有结果均在Rocq中机械化。
AI.translation: 严格性分析对于非严格求值语言的高效实现至关重要，它能减轻惰性带来的大部分性能开销。然而，在源代码级别推理严格性可能具有挑战性且不直观。我们提出了一种新的严格性定义，通过更精确地描述变量的使用来改进传统的定义。我们借鉴了跟踪效应和共效应的类型系统文献，在传名调用（call-by-name）和传值传名（call-by-push-value）设置中为该定义奠定了类型理论基础。我们通过逻辑关系证明了我们的类型系统计算出的严格性属性准确地描述了变量在运行时的使用，并且我们提供了一个从传名调用系统到传值传名系统的保持严格性标注的翻译。我们所有的结果都在Rocq中进行了机械化。
AI.summary: 本文旨在解决非严格求值语言中严格性分析在源代码级别推理困难的问题。作者提出了一种新的、更精确的严格性定义，用于精确描述变量使用。他们为该定义在传名调用和传值传名环境中建立了类型理论基础，并利用逻辑关系证明了类型系统计算出的严格性属性在运行时是准确的。此外，论文还提供了一个保持严格性标注的系统间翻译，所有结果均已在Rocq中机械化验证。
AI.keywords: 严格性分析, 类型系统, 传名调用, 传值传名, 惰性求值
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了一个更精细的严格性定义，通过借鉴跟踪效应和共效应的类型系统，将现代类型理论应用于解决非严格语言的性能优化这一经典问题。通过在传名调用（CBN）和传值传名（CBPV）两种设置中进行类型理论基础的奠定，并使用逻辑关系证明准确性，体现了高度的理论严谨性。所有结果在Rocq中机械化验证，进一步增强了结果的可信度和实用性，对于提高惰性求值语言的编译器效率具有重要意义。

title: See or Say Graphs: Agent-Driven Scalable Graph Structure Understanding with Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have shown promise in graph structure understanding, but remain limited by input-token constraints, facing scalability bottlenecks and lacking effective mechanisms to coordinate textual and visual modalities. To address these challenges, we propose GraphVista, a unified framework that enhances both scalability and modality coordination in graph structure understanding. For scalability, GraphVista organizes graph information hierarchically into a lightweight GraphRAG base, which retrieves only task-relevant textual descriptions and high-resolution visual subgraphs, compressing redundant context while preserving key reasoning elements. For modality coordination, GraphVista introduces a planning agent that decomposes and routes tasks to the most suitable modality-using the text modality for direct access to explicit graph properties and the visual modality for local graph structure reasoning grounded in explicit topology. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GraphVista scales to large graphs, up to 200$\times$ larger than those used in existing benchmarks, and consistently outperforms existing textual, visual, and fusion-based methods, achieving up to 4.4$\times$ quality improvement over the state-of-the-art baselines by fully exploiting the complementary strengths of both modalities.

AI.title_translation: 看或说图：智能体驱动的可扩展图结构理解与视觉-语言模型
AI.tldr: 视觉-语言模型（VLMs）在图结构理解中存在可扩展性和模态协调问题。GraphVista通过分层GraphRAG和规划智能体解决了这些挑战，显著提高了大型图上的性能，并有效利用了视觉和文本模态的互补优势。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言模型（VLMs）在图结构理解方面受到输入令牌限制，面临可扩展性瓶颈，并且缺乏有效协调文本和视觉模态的机制。
AI.method: GraphVista是一个统一框架，用于增强图结构理解的可扩展性和模态协调。为解决可扩展性问题，它将图信息分层组织到轻量级GraphRAG基础中，检索任务相关的文本描述和高分辨率视觉子图。为解决模态协调问题，它引入了一个规划智能体，将任务分解并路由到最合适的模态（文本用于直接访问显式图属性，视觉用于基于显式拓扑的局部图结构推理）。
AI.result: GraphVista可扩展到比现有基准大200倍的图。它持续优于现有的文本、视觉和融合方法，通过充分利用两种模态的互补优势，实现了比现有最先进基线高达4.4倍的质量提升。
AI.conclusion: GraphVista通过分层信息组织和智能代理驱动的模态协调，成功解决了视觉-语言模型在图结构理解中面临的可扩展性瓶颈和模态协调问题，并在大型图上展现出卓越的性能。
AI.translation: 视觉-语言模型（VLMs）在图结构理解方面展现出潜力，但仍受限于输入令牌约束，面临可扩展性瓶颈，并缺乏有效协调文本和视觉模态的机制。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了GraphVista，一个统一的框架，旨在增强图结构理解中的可扩展性和模态协调。在可扩展性方面，GraphVista将图信息分层组织成一个轻量级的GraphRAG基础，该基础仅检索与任务相关的文本描述和高分辨率视觉子图，从而压缩冗余上下文，同时保留关键的推理元素。在模态协调方面，GraphVista引入了一个规划智能体，该智能体将任务分解并路由到最适合的模态——使用文本模态直接访问显式图属性，使用视觉模态进行基于显式拓扑的局部图结构推理。广泛的实验表明，GraphVista可以扩展到大型图，其规模比现有基准中使用的图大200倍，并且持续优于现有的文本、视觉和基于融合的方法，通过充分利用两种模态的互补优势，实现了比现有最先进基线高达4.4倍的质量提升。
AI.summary: GraphVista是一个创新的统一框架，旨在解决视觉-语言模型在图结构理解中面临的可扩展性瓶颈和模态协调问题。它通过分层GraphRAG基础来高效组织和检索图信息，并通过一个规划智能体智能地协调文本和视觉模态的使用。实验证明，GraphVista能够处理大规模图，并且在性能上显著优于现有方法。
AI.keywords: 视觉-语言模型, 图结构理解, 可扩展性, 模态协调, GraphRAG, 规划智能体
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一个名为GraphVista的统一框架，有效解决了视觉-语言模型在图结构理解中遇到的两大核心挑战：可扩展性不足和模态协调效率低下。通过引入轻量级GraphRAG进行分层信息组织和任务相关的检索，以及设计一个规划智能体来智能地分配任务到最合适的模态，GraphVista显著提升了模型处理大型图的能力（高达200倍），并实现了高达4.4倍的质量提升。这对于将VLM应用于更复杂、更大规模的图分析任务具有重要意义。

title: Low-dimensional semi-supervised latent Bayesian optimization for designing antimicrobial peptides
comments: (Submitted version) v2: 22 pages, 9 figures. Expanded discussion section. Made large figure clearer. Small title and abstract change. Edits to results to make points clearer, but no drastic changes
summary: Antimicrobial peptides (AMPs) are a promising class of therapeutics to treat bacterial infections. Discovering and designing such peptides is difficult because of the vast number of possible sequences of amino acids. Deep generative models, such as variational autoencoders, have shown value in peptide design due to their ability to model sequence space with a continuous-valued latent space. Although such models have already been used to great effect in biomolecular design, they still suffer from a lack of interpretability and rigorous quantification of latent space quality as a search space. We investigate (1) whether searching through a dimensionally-reduced variant of the latent design space may facilitate optimization, (2) how organizing latent spaces with physicochemical properties may improve the efficiency of optimizing antimicrobial activity, and (3) the interpretability of the spaces. We find that employing a dimensionally-reduced version of the latent space is more interpretable and can be advantageous, while we can organize the latent space with different physicochemical properties even at different percentages of available labels. This work lays crucial groundwork for biophysically-motivated peptide design procedures.
